decisions.choice: The word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came to me, saying: (L); came to me: (B); {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} gave me this message: (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this formula, which opens each new oracle in chapters 12-15. As at 11:14, the oracle that follows is not put in quotation marks; only words quoted within it are.

decisions.choice: "Vino a mí la palabra del SEÑOR, diciendo:" (L); "La palabra del SEÑOR vino a mí:" (B); "El SEÑOR me dio este mensaje:" (R)
decisions.reason: The formula that opens each oracle, worded as in Jeremiah and kept wherever it returns in these chapters. As in the English, the oracle that follows takes no quotation marks; only human speech quoted inside it takes « ».

decisions.choice: "Neno la BWANA likanijia, kusema:" (L); "Neno la BWANA likanijia:" (B); "BWANA alinipa ujumbe huu:" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's formula for a new message, worded as in the Swahili Jeremiah (1:4) and used the same way through chapters 12-18. Readable makes the LORD the subject, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "주의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 말씀하셨다" (L), "…임했다" (B), "주께서 나에게 이 말씀을 주셨다" (R) for the word-event formula, throughout Ezekiel 12-18
alternatives: "주의 말씀이 나에게 임하여 이르시되" (older church style)
decisions.reason: The formula of the Isaiah-Jeremiah note, so these chapters match Jeremiah 1:4. Ezekiel narrates in the first person in the plain written style and gives God the honorific -시- (말씀하셨다, 주셨다); the English colon becomes a Korean period, and the oracle that follows takes no quotation marks.

decisions.choice: ’Et la parole du SEIGNEUR me fut adressée, disant :’ (L); ’La parole du SEIGNEUR me fut adressée :’ (B); ’Le SEIGNEUR m’a donné ce message :’ (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: Ezekiel’s recurring formula takes the wording settled for Jeremiah 1:4, built on the Kings formula ’la parole du SEIGNEUR fut adressée à X’; each level keeps one wording through the book.

decisions.choice: passé simple for Ezekiel’s own narration at L and B (’me fut adressée’, ’je fis’); passé composé at R (’m’a donné’, ’j’ai fait’); God’s oracles are speech at every level (present, future, passé composé)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel tells in the first person what he was told and what he did, which French written narrative puts in the passé simple, Readable in the passé composé, as Jeremiah’s and John’s first-person narration. The oracles themselves never take the passé simple.

decisions.choice: "Lời CHÚA đến với tôi rằng:" (L); "Lời CHÚA đến với tôi:" (B); "CHÚA ban cho tôi sứ điệp này:" (R)
alternatives: "Có lời CHÚA phán cùng tôi rằng"
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms for this formula, as in Isaiah and Jeremiah; the oracle that follows takes no quotation marks. Used unchanged through Ezekiel 12-18.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in the Amharic of this chapter
decisions.reason: The Ethiopic script has no capital letters, so the setting that capitalises pronouns for God has nothing to change; the English spans in this chapter have no Amharic counterpart.

decisions.choice: {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} का वचन मेरे पास पहुँचा (L, B); {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} ने मुझे यह संदेश दिया (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Hindi wording for "the word of the LORD came to me", as Jeremiah 1:4; it opens each oracle in this chapter.

records.literal_gloss: Son of man, in [the] midst of the house of rebellion you [are] living, who [have] eyes to see but do not see, ears to hear but do not hear, for a house of rebellion they [are].

en.L: Son of man, you are living in the midst of the house of rebellion, who have eyes to see but do not see, who have ears to hear but do not hear; for they [are] a house of rebellion.
en.B: Son of man, you live among a rebellious house. They have eyes that can see, yet they do not see, and ears that can hear, yet they do not hear, because they are a rebellious house.
en.R: Son of man, you are living among people who refuse to obey. They have eyes that could see, but they do not see. They have ears that could hear, but they do not hear. They are people who refuse to obey.

pt.L: Filho do homem, tu habitas no meio da casa de rebelião, que têm olhos para ver, mas não veem, que têm ouvidos para ouvir, mas não ouvem; pois eles [são] uma casa de rebelião.
pt.B: Filho do homem, tu moras no meio de uma casa rebelde. Eles têm olhos para ver, mas não veem, e ouvidos para ouvir, mas não ouvem, porque são uma casa rebelde.
pt.R: Filho do homem, tu estás morando no meio de um povo que se recusa a obedecer. Eles têm olhos que poderiam ver, mas não veem. Têm ouvidos que poderiam ouvir, mas não ouvem. Eles são um povo que se recusa a obedecer.

es.L: Hijo de hombre, tú habitas en medio de la casa de rebelión, los cuales tienen ojos para ver y no ven, tienen oídos para oír y no oyen; porque ellos [son] una casa de rebelión.
es.B: Hijo de hombre, vives en medio de una casa rebelde. Tienen ojos para ver, pero no ven; tienen oídos para oír, pero no oyen, porque son una casa rebelde.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, vives en medio de un pueblo que se niega a obedecer. Tienen ojos que podrían ver, pero no ven. Tienen oídos que podrían oír, pero no oyen. Son un pueblo que se niega a obedecer.

sw.L: Mwana wa binadamu, wewe unakaa katikati ya nyumba ya uasi, ambao wana macho ya kuona lakini hawaoni, wana masikio ya kusikia lakini hawasikii; kwa maana wao [ni] nyumba ya uasi.
sw.B: Mwana wa binadamu, unaishi kati ya nyumba ya waasi. Wana macho ya kuona, lakini hawaoni; wana masikio ya kusikia, lakini hawasikii, kwa sababu wao ni nyumba ya waasi.
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, unaishi kati ya watu wanaokataa kutii. Wana macho yanayoweza kuona, lakini hawaoni. Wana masikio yanayoweza kusikia, lakini hawasikii. Wao ni watu wanaokataa kutii.

ko.L: 사람의 아들아, 너는 반역의 집 한가운데에 살고 있다. 그들은 볼 눈이 있으나 보지 않고, 들을 귀가 있으나 듣지 않는다. 그들은 반역의 집이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 사람의 아들아, 너는 반역하는 족속 가운데 살고 있다. 그들은 볼 수 있는 눈이 있는데도 보지 않고, 들을 수 있는 귀가 있는데도 듣지 않는다. 그들이 반역하는 족속이기 때문이다.
ko.R: 사람의 아들아, 너는 말을 듣지 않는 백성 가운데 살고 있다. 그들은 볼 수 있는 눈이 있지만 보지 않는다. 들을 수 있는 귀가 있지만 듣지 않는다. 그들은 말을 듣지 않는 백성이다.

fr.L: Fils d’homme, tu habites au milieu de la maison de rébellion, qui ont des yeux pour voir et ne voient pas, qui ont des oreilles pour entendre et n’entendent pas, car ils [sont] une maison de rébellion.
fr.B: Fils d’homme, tu habites au milieu d’une maison rebelle. Ils ont des yeux pour voir, mais ils ne voient pas, des oreilles pour entendre, mais ils n’entendent pas, car c’est une maison rebelle.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, tu vis au milieu d’un peuple qui refuse d’obéir. Ces gens ont des yeux qui pourraient voir, mais ils ne voient pas. Ils ont des oreilles qui pourraient entendre, mais ils n’entendent pas. C’est un peuple qui refuse d’obéir.

vi.L: Hỡi con người, ngươi đang sống giữa nhà của sự phản nghịch, là những kẻ có mắt để thấy mà không thấy, có tai để nghe mà không nghe; vì chúng [là] nhà của sự phản nghịch.
vi.B: Hỡi con người, con đang sống giữa nhà phản nghịch. Chúng có mắt để thấy nhưng không thấy, có tai để nghe nhưng không nghe, vì chúng là nhà phản nghịch.
vi.R: Hỡi con người, con đang sống giữa một dân không chịu vâng lời. Chúng có mắt có thể thấy, nhưng chúng không thấy. Chúng có tai có thể nghe, nhưng chúng không nghe. Chúng là dân không chịu vâng lời.

am.L: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ አንተ በዓመፀኛ ቤት መካከል ትኖራለህ፤ እነርሱ ለማየት ዓይኖች አሏቸው፤ ግን አያዩም፤ ለመስማት ጆሮዎች አሏቸው፤ ግን አይሰሙም፤ ዓመፀኛ ቤት ናቸውና።

am.R: የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ የምትኖረው በማይታዘዙ ሰዎች መካከል ነው። ማየት የሚችሉ ዓይኖች አሏቸው፤ ነገር ግን አያዩም። መስማት የሚችሉ ጆሮዎች አሏቸው፤ ነገር ግን አይሰሙም። እነርሱ የማይታዘዙ ሰዎች ናቸው።

hi.L: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, तुम विद्रोह के घराने के बीच में रहते हो, जिनकी आँखें देखने को [हैं] पर वे नहीं देखते, जिनके कान सुनने को [हैं] पर वे नहीं सुनते; क्योंकि वे विद्रोह का घराना [हैं]।
hi.B: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, तुम एक विद्रोही घराने के बीच रहते हो। उनके पास देखने को आँखें हैं, फिर भी वे नहीं देखते; सुनने को कान हैं, फिर भी वे नहीं सुनते, क्योंकि वे विद्रोही घराना हैं।
hi.R: हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, तुम आज्ञा न माननेवाले लोगों के बीच रहते हो। उनकी आँखें देख सकती हैं, पर वे नहीं देखते। उनके कान सुन सकते हैं, पर वे नहीं सुनते। वे आज्ञा न माननेवाले लोग हैं।

ru.L: Сын человеческий, ты живёшь посреди дома мятежа, у которых есть глаза, чтобы видеть, но не видят, есть уши, чтобы слышать, но не слышат; ведь они — дом мятежа.
ru.B: Сын человеческий, ты живёшь среди мятежного дома. У них есть глаза, чтобы видеть, но они не видят, и уши, чтобы слышать, но они не слышат, потому что они — мятежный дом.
ru.R: Сын человеческий, ты живёшь среди непослушного народа. У них есть глаза, которые могли бы видеть, но они не видят. У них есть уши, которые могли бы слышать, но они не слышат. Это непослушный народ.

ja.L: 人の子よ、あなたは反逆の家のただ中に住んでいる。彼らには見るための目があるが見ず、聞くための耳があるが聞かない。彼らは反逆の家だからである。
ja.B: 人の子よ、あなたは反逆の家の中に住んでいる。彼らには見る目があるのに見ず、聞く耳があるのに聞かない。彼らは反逆の家なのだ。
ja.R: 人よ、あなたは、わたしに従おうとしない民の中に住んでいる。彼らには、見ることのできる目があるのに、見ようとしない。聞くことのできる耳があるのに、聞こうとしない。彼らは、わたしに従おうとしない民だからだ。

decisions.choice: the house of rebellion: Ezekiel's name for Israel (see 2:5)
decisions.reason: See 2:5. The phrase frames the verse, at its start and its end.

decisions.choice: eyes to see but do not see, ears to hear but do not hear: the charge of Isaiah 6:9-10 and Jeremiah 5:21
decisions.reason: The people can see and hear but will not take in what they see and hear. Jeremiah 5:21 uses nearly the same words, and Jesus takes them up in Mark 8:18. The sign that follows is acted out for people who will not listen to words.

decisions.choice: house of rebellion (L); rebellious house (B); people who refuse to obey (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this phrase in Ezekiel (see 2:5).

decisions.choice: "hijo de hombre" at every level, lowercase except at the start of a sentence
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel means "human being". It is kept at every level, as the English does, and is never written "Hijo del Hombre", the Gospels' title of Jesus. No gender span: Ezekiel is one man.

decisions.choice: "la casa de rebelión" (L); "una casa rebelde" (B); "un pueblo que se niega a obedecer" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's name for Israel, worded at each level as the terms note sets it and kept wherever it returns.

decisions.choice: "mwana wa binadamu", lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: God's address to Ezekiel means "human being" and is kept as a phrase, as the English keeps "son of man". It is worded apart from Jesus' title "Mwana wa Adamu" and written lowercase, with no gender span, since it addresses one man. Used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "nyumba ya uasi" (L); "nyumba ya waasi" (B); "watu wanaokataa kutii" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's name for Israel, worded at each level as the English: the Hebrew phrase (L), a rebellious house (B), and the plain sense (R). Used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "사람의 아들아" for God's address to Ezekiel (ben-adam), at every level
decisions.reason: As decided at 2:1: 인자 is Jesus's title in the Korean New Testament, and Ezekiel's address means only "human being", so it is kept plain. No gender span, since Ezekiel is one man.

decisions.choice: "반역의 집" (L), "반역하는 족속" (B), "말을 듣지 않는 백성" (R) for bet meri, through these chapters
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for Ezekiel's name for Israel (see 2:5); R says plainly what the rebellion is, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: ’fils d’homme’ at every level, lowercase, no article, for the whole book
decisions.reason: God’s address to Ezekiel means ’human being’ and stresses that he is a mortal; ’le Fils de l’homme’ with the article is Jesus’s title in the Gospels, so French keeps the plain form without the article, as the English keeps ’son of man’ at every level. No gender span: Ezekiel is one man.

decisions.choice: ’la maison de rébellion’ (L); ’une maison rebelle’ (B); ’un peuple qui refuse d’obéir’ (R), for the whole book
decisions.reason: Ezekiel’s name for Israel, kept as the English keeps it at each level. ’Maison’ is feminine but the Hebrew goes on in the plural (’they have eyes’), so French writes ’ils’ after it, as the Hebrew does.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi con người," lowercase, at every level
decisions.reason: "Con người" is the ordinary Vietnamese word for a human being, which is what God's address to Ezekiel means (see 2:1). It is never capitalised: "Con Người" is kept for Jesus' title in the Gospels (Matthew 24:30). No setting span. Used unchanged through these chapters.

decisions.choice: God to Ezekiel: "ngươi" (L); "con" (B, R); Ezekiel says "tôi"; the people judged are "chúng"
decisions.reason: The terms note's address for God commissioning a prophet: "ngươi" at Literal, the warmer "con" at Balanced and Readable, as with Isaiah and Jeremiah. The rebellious people are "chúng" in the oracles. "House of rebellion" is "nhà của sự phản nghịch" (L) / "nhà phản nghịch" (B) / "dân không chịu vâng lời" (R).

decisions.choice: "ዓመፀኛ ቤት" (L, B); "የማይታዘዙ ሰዎች" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms list fixes "ዓመፀኛ ቤት" for Ezekiel's "house of rebellion" through the book; Literal uses it too, since "የዓመፅ ቤት" would sound like a house of violence. Readable follows the English "people who refuse to obey".

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Hindi
alternatives: deity_pronoun spans as in the English
decisions.reason: The English marks God's pronouns with the deity_pronoun setting. Devanagari has no capital letters, so the Hindi has no such spans; respect for God is carried by the honorific third person. This holds for the whole file.

decisions.choice: विद्रोह का घराना (L); विद्रोही घराना (B); आज्ञा न माननेवाले लोग (R), as 2:5
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's name for Israel, "the house of rebellion", follows the three English levels: the noun at Literal, the adjective at Balanced, and at Readable what the rebellion is. विद्रोही as Isaiah 65:2. One wording per level through these chapters.

decisions.choice: дом мятежа (L); мятежный дом (B); непослушный народ (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's name for Israel (m1) in the wording set at 2:5: Literal keeps the Hebrew's noun, Balanced says "мятежный дом", Readable says what the "house" is, a people, and what they do.

decisions.choice: "見るための目があるが見ず、聞くための耳があるが聞かない" (L), "見る目があるのに見ず、聞く耳があるのに聞かない" (B), "…見ようとしない…聞こうとしない" (R); bet meri as notes/EZK-EZK-1.md.
decisions.reason: The charge of Isaiah 6:9-10 and Jeremiah 5:21 (m2); Readable says the refusal is their will, as the English R's frame "refuse to obey".

source.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם עֲשֵׂ֤ה לְךָ֙ כְּלֵ֣י גוֹלָ֔ה וּגְלֵ֥ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְגָלִ֨יתָ מִמְּקוֹמְךָ֜ אֶל־מָק֤וֹם אַחֵר֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם אוּלַ֣י יִרְא֔וּ כִּ֛י בֵּ֥ית מְרִ֖י הֵֽמָּה׃

records.literal_gloss: And you, son of man, make for yourself baggage of exile, and go into exile by day in their sight; and you will go into exile from your place to another place in their sight. Perhaps they will see, for a house of rebellion they [are].

en.L: And you, son of man, make for yourself an exile's baggage, and go into exile by day before their eyes; you shall go into exile from your place to another place before their eyes. Perhaps they will see, though they [are] a house of rebellion.
en.B: So you, son of man, pack your belongings for exile, and in daylight, while they watch, set out as one going into exile. Go from your place to another place while they watch. Perhaps they will understand, rebellious house though they are.
en.R: So, son of man, pack your things as if you were being taken away as a captive. Then, in the daytime, while they are watching, leave your home and go to another place. Maybe they will understand, even though they are people who refuse to obey.

pt.L: E tu, filho do homem, prepara para ti uma bagagem de exilado, e vai para o exílio de dia diante dos olhos deles; irás para o exílio do teu lugar para outro lugar diante dos olhos deles. Talvez vejam, embora eles [sejam] uma casa de rebelião.
pt.B: Por isso, filho do homem, arruma os teus pertences para o exílio e, de dia, enquanto eles olham, parte como quem vai para o exílio. Sai do teu lugar para outro lugar enquanto eles olham. Talvez entendam, mesmo sendo uma casa rebelde.
pt.R: Por isso, filho do homem, arruma as tuas coisas como se estivesses sendo levado como prisioneiro. Depois, de dia, enquanto eles estão olhando, sai da tua casa e vai para outro lugar. Talvez eles entendam, mesmo sendo um povo que se recusa a obedecer.

es.L: Y tú, hijo de hombre, hazte un equipaje de destierro, y sal al destierro de día, ante sus ojos; saldrás al destierro de tu lugar a otro lugar ante sus ojos. Quizá vean, aunque ellos [son] una casa de rebelión.
es.B: Así que tú, hijo de hombre, prepara tu equipaje para el destierro y, de día, mientras ellos miran, sal como quien va al destierro. Ve de tu lugar a otro lugar mientras ellos miran. Quizá entiendan, aunque son una casa rebelde.
es.R: Así que, hijo de hombre, prepara tus cosas como si te llevaran cautivo. Luego, durante el día, mientras te miran, sal de tu casa y vete a otro lugar. Tal vez entiendan, aunque son un pueblo que se niega a obedecer.

sw.L: Nawe, mwana wa binadamu, jitengenezee mizigo ya uhamisho, uhame mchana mbele ya macho yao; utahama kutoka mahali pako kwenda mahali pengine mbele ya macho yao. Huenda wataona, ingawa wao [ni] nyumba ya uasi.
sw.B: Basi wewe, mwana wa binadamu, funga mizigo yako ya uhamisho, na mchana, wakiwa wanatazama, ondoka kama mtu anayekwenda uhamishoni. Toka mahali pako uende mahali pengine wakiwa wanatazama. Huenda wataelewa, ingawa wao ni nyumba ya waasi.
sw.R: Basi, mwana wa binadamu, funga vitu vyako kana kwamba unachukuliwa mateka. Kisha, wakati wa mchana, wakiwa wanakutazama, toka nyumbani kwako uende mahali pengine. Huenda wataelewa, ingawa wao ni watu wanaokataa kutii.

ko.L: 그러니 너 사람의 아들아, 너를 위하여 포로의 짐을 꾸리고, 낮에 그들의 눈앞에서 포로로 떠나가거라. 그들의 눈앞에서 네가 있는 곳을 떠나 다른 곳으로 포로가 되어 가거라. 그들이 반역의 집이지만, 혹시 볼지도 모른다.
ko.B: 그러므로 너 사람의 아들아, 포로로 끌려갈 때 가지고 갈 짐을 꾸려라. 그리고 대낮에 그들이 보는 앞에서 포로로 끌려가는 사람처럼 길을 나서라. 그들이 보는 앞에서 네가 있는 곳을 떠나 다른 곳으로 가거라. 그들이 반역하는 족속이기는 하지만, 혹시 깨달을지도 모른다.
ko.R: 그러니 사람의 아들아, 포로로 끌려가는 사람처럼 네 짐을 싸라. 그리고 낮에 그들이 지켜보는 동안 네 집을 떠나 다른 곳으로 가거라. 그들이 말을 듣지 않는 백성이기는 하지만, 어쩌면 깨달을지도 모른다.

fr.L: Et toi, fils d’homme, fais-toi un bagage d’exil, et pars en exil de jour sous leurs yeux ; tu partiras en exil de ton lieu vers un autre lieu sous leurs yeux. Peut-être verront-ils, bien qu’ils [soient] une maison de rébellion.
fr.B: Toi donc, fils d’homme, prépare tes affaires comme pour l’exil, et en plein jour, sous leurs yeux, pars comme on part en exil. Quitte ta demeure pour un autre lieu sous leurs yeux. Peut-être comprendront-ils, toute maison rebelle qu’ils sont.
fr.R: Alors, fils d’homme, prépare tes affaires comme si on t’emmenait en captivité. Puis, pendant la journée, sous leurs yeux, quitte ta maison et va dans un autre endroit. Peut-être qu’ils comprendront, même si c’est un peuple qui refuse d’obéir.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, hỡi con người, hãy chuẩn bị cho mình hành trang của kẻ lưu đày, và hãy đi lưu đày ban ngày trước mắt chúng; ngươi sẽ đi lưu đày từ chỗ của ngươi đến một chỗ khác trước mắt chúng. Có lẽ chúng sẽ thấy, dù chúng [là] nhà của sự phản nghịch.
vi.B: Vậy, hỡi con người, con hãy sắp xếp hành trang như người đi lưu đày, rồi giữa ban ngày, khi chúng đang nhìn, hãy lên đường như một người bị đưa đi lưu đày. Hãy rời chỗ con ở mà đi đến một nơi khác trước mắt chúng. Có lẽ chúng sẽ hiểu, dù chúng là nhà phản nghịch.
vi.R: Vậy, hỡi con người, con hãy gói ghém đồ đạc như thể con sắp bị bắt đi làm tù binh. Rồi vào ban ngày, khi chúng đang nhìn, con hãy rời nhà mình mà đi đến một nơi khác. Có lẽ chúng sẽ hiểu, dù chúng là dân không chịu vâng lời.

am.L: አንተም የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ የስደት ጓዝ ለራስህ አዘጋጅ፤ በቀንም በዓይናቸው ፊት ተሰደድ፤ ከስፍራህም ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ በዓይናቸው ፊት ትሰደዳለህ። ዓመፀኛ ቤት ቢሆኑም ምናልባት ያዩ ይሆናል።
am.B: ስለዚህ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ ለስደት የሚሆን ጓዝህን አዘጋጅ፤ በቀን ብርሃንም እያዩህ እንደ ተሰደደ ሰው ተነሥተህ ሂድ። እያዩህ ከስፍራህ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ ሂድ። ዓመፀኛ ቤት ቢሆኑም ምናልባት ያስተውሉ ይሆናል።
am.R: ስለዚህ የሰው ልጅ ሆይ፣ እንደ ተማረከ ሰው ጓዝህን አዘጋጅ። ከዚያም በቀን እያዩህ ቤትህን ትተህ ወደ ሌላ ስፍራ ሂድ። የማይታዘዙ ሰዎች ቢሆኑም ምናልባት ያስተውሉ ይሆናል።

hi.L: और तुम, हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, अपने लिए बंधुआई का सामान तैयार करो, और दिन को उनकी आँखों के सामने बंधुआई में चले जाओ; उनकी आँखों के सामने तुम अपने स्थान से दूसरे स्थान को बंधुआई में जाओगे। शायद वे देखें, यद्यपि वे विद्रोह का घराना [हैं]।
hi.B: इसलिए, हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, बंधुआई के लिए अपना सामान बाँधो, और दिन के उजाले में, उनके देखते-देखते, बंधुआई में जानेवाले की तरह निकल पड़ो। उनके देखते हुए अपने स्थान से दूसरे स्थान को जाओ। शायद वे समझ जाएँ, यद्यपि वे विद्रोही घराना हैं।
hi.R: इसलिए, हे मनुष्य की सन्तान, अपना सामान ऐसे बाँधो मानो तुम्हें बंदी बनाकर ले जाया जा रहा हो। फिर दिन के समय, जब वे देख रहे हों, अपना घर छोड़कर किसी दूसरी जगह चले जाओ। शायद वे समझ जाएँ, यद्यपि वे आज्ञा न माननेवाले लोग हैं।

ru.L: А ты, сын человеческий, сделай себе вещи изгнанника и уходи в изгнание днём у них на глазах; уйдёшь в изгнание со своего места в другое место у них на глазах. Может быть, они увидят, хотя они — дом мятежа.
ru.B: А ты, сын человеческий, собери свои вещи, как для изгнания, и днём, у них на глазах, отправляйся, как уходящий в изгнание. Иди со своего места в другое место у них на глазах. Может быть, они поймут, хотя они и мятежный дом.
ru.R: Сын человеческий, собери свои вещи так, как будто тебя уводят в плен. Потом днём, когда они будут смотреть, уйди из своего дома в другое место. Может быть, они поймут, хотя это непослушный народ.

ja.L: そしてあなた、人の子よ、捕囚の荷物を自分のために作り、昼間、彼らの目の前で捕囚として出て行きなさい。あなたは彼らの目の前で、あなたの場所からほかの場所へ捕囚として移って行きなさい。彼らは反逆の家であるが、もしかすると見るかもしれない。
ja.B: 人の子よ、あなたは捕囚に出る人のように荷物をまとめ、昼間、彼らが見ている前で、捕囚として出て行きなさい。彼らの見ている前で、あなたの場所からほかの場所へ移りなさい。彼らは反逆の家だが、もしかすると悟るかもしれない。
ja.R: 人よ、捕虜として連れて行かれる人のように、荷物をまとめなさい。そして昼間、彼らが見ている前で家を出て、ほかの場所へ行きなさい。彼らはわたしに従おうとしない民だが、もしかすると分かるかもしれない。

decisions.choice: an exile's baggage: the few things a deportee could carry
decisions.reason: People taken into exile could take only what they could carry on their backs (compare Jeremiah 46:19). Ezekiel is to pack such a bundle and carry it out in plain view.

decisions.choice: a sign acted out: Ezekiel's actions carry the message
decisions.reason: Like the signs of 4:1-5:4, this is a message performed rather than spoken. Ezekiel, already an exile in Babylon, acts out the exile still to come for those left in Jerusalem (12:10-11).

decisions.choice: perhaps they will see, though they are rebellious
alternatives: perhaps they will see that they are a rebellious house
decisions.reason: The word joining the last clause can mean "though" or "for", and it can also introduce what they might see: that they are a rebellious house. The sense of hope against the odds is the same.

decisions.choice: as if you were being taken away as a captive
alternatives: an exile's baggage; go into exile
decisions.reason: Readable explains what going into exile means, since the word "exile" may not be known to young readers.

decisions.choice: uma bagagem de exilado (L); os teus pertences para o exílio (B); as tuas coisas, como se estivesses sendo levado como prisioneiro (R); ir para o exílio
decisions.reason: For the sign of the exile (12:3-12): Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase, "bagagem de exilado" (m1); Balanced says "pertences", and the bundle carried on the shoulder is "a trouxa" (verses 6, 12); Readable explains what going into exile means, as the English Readable does (r-en-1). The verb galah is "ir para o exílio" at Literal and Balanced. The act is "um sinal" (verse 6), the word set at 4:3.

decisions.choice: "equipaje de destierro" (L); "equipaje para el destierro" (B); "tus cosas" (R)
decisions.reason: The few belongings a deportee could carry; "destierro" is the published word for the exile in Kings and Chronicles.

decisions.choice: вещи изгнанника (L); вещи, как для изгнания (B, R)
decisions.reason: The few things a deportee could carry (m1): the plain word "вещи" at every level.

decisions.choice: kele golah "捕囚の荷物" (L), "捕囚に出る人のように荷物をまとめ" (B), "捕虜として連れて行かれる人のように、荷物をまとめなさい" (R); galah "捕囚として出て行く / 移る" (L, B); 'ulai "もしかすると…かもしれない".
decisions.reason: The few things a deportee could carry (m1); the act is a sign (m2). The 'though / for' of the last clause is uncertain (m3); Japanese takes it as concessive with the English.

source.text: וְהוֹצֵאתָ֨ כֵלֶ֜יךָ כִּכְלֵ֥י גוֹלָ֛ה יוֹמָ֖ם לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְאַתָּ֗ה תֵּצֵ֤א בָעֶ֨רֶב֙ לְעֵ֣ינֵיהֶ֔ם כְּמוֹצָאֵ֖י גּוֹלָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And bring out your baggage like baggage of exile by day in their sight; and you, go out in the evening in their sight, like those going out [into] exile.

en.L: And you shall bring out your baggage like an exile's baggage by day before their eyes; and you yourself shall go out in the evening before their eyes, like those who go out into exile.
en.B: Bring out your belongings by day while they watch, like belongings packed for exile. Then in the evening, while they watch, go out yourself like people going into exile.
en.R: During the day, while they are watching, bring out your things packed as if for exile. Then in the evening, while they are watching, leave like a captive being taken away.

pt.L: E tirarás a tua bagagem como bagagem de exilado, de dia, diante dos olhos deles; e tu mesmo sairás à tarde diante dos olhos deles, como os que saem para o exílio.
pt.B: Tira os teus pertences de dia, enquanto eles olham, como pertences arrumados para o exílio. Depois, à tarde, enquanto eles olham, sai tu mesmo como gente que vai para o exílio.
pt.R: Durante o dia, enquanto eles estão olhando, tira para fora as tuas coisas arrumadas como para o exílio. Depois, à tarde, enquanto eles estão olhando, sai como um prisioneiro que está sendo levado embora.

es.L: Y sacarás tu equipaje como equipaje de destierro, de día, ante sus ojos; y tú saldrás por la tarde ante sus ojos, como los que salen al destierro.
es.B: Saca tu equipaje de día, mientras ellos miran, como equipaje preparado para el destierro. Luego, por la tarde, mientras miran, sal tú mismo como la gente que va al destierro.
es.R: Durante el día, mientras te miran, saca tus cosas empacadas como para ir al destierro. Luego, por la tarde, mientras te miran, sal como un cautivo al que se llevan.

sw.L: Nawe utatoa mizigo yako kama mizigo ya uhamisho mchana mbele ya macho yao; nawe mwenyewe utatoka jioni mbele ya macho yao, kama wale wanaotoka kwenda uhamishoni.
sw.B: Toa mizigo yako mchana wakiwa wanatazama, kama mizigo iliyofungwa kwa ajili ya uhamisho. Kisha jioni, wakiwa wanatazama, toka wewe mwenyewe kama watu wanaokwenda uhamishoni.
sw.R: Wakati wa mchana, wakiwa wanatazama, toa vitu vyako vilivyofungwa kana kwamba unakwenda uhamishoni. Kisha jioni, wakiwa wanatazama, ondoka kama mateka anayechukuliwa.

ko.L: 너는 낮에 그들의 눈앞에서 네 짐을 포로의 짐처럼 내어 놓아라. 그리고 너는 저녁에 그들의 눈앞에서 포로로 끌려 나가는 자들처럼 나가거라.
ko.B: 낮에 그들이 보는 앞에서, 포로로 끌려갈 때 꾸린 짐처럼 네 짐을 밖으로 내놓아라. 그리고 저녁에 그들이 보는 앞에서, 포로로 끌려가는 사람들처럼 너 자신이 나가거라.
ko.R: 낮에 그들이 지켜보는 동안, 포로로 끌려갈 때처럼 싼 짐을 밖으로 내놓아라. 그리고 저녁에 그들이 지켜보는 동안, 포로로 끌려가는 사람처럼 집을 나서라.

fr.L: Et tu sortiras ton bagage comme un bagage d’exil, de jour, sous leurs yeux ; et toi, tu sortiras le soir sous leurs yeux, comme sortent ceux qui partent en exil.
fr.B: Sors tes affaires de jour, sous leurs yeux, comme des affaires préparées pour l’exil. Puis le soir, sous leurs yeux, sors toi-même comme des gens qui partent en exil.
fr.R: Pendant la journée, sous leurs yeux, sors tes affaires préparées comme pour l’exil. Puis le soir, pendant qu’ils regardent, pars comme un prisonnier qu’on emmène.

vi.L: Ngươi hãy đem hành trang của ngươi ra như hành trang của kẻ lưu đày vào ban ngày trước mắt chúng; còn chính ngươi hãy đi ra vào buổi chiều trước mắt chúng, như những người đi ra lưu đày.
vi.B: Ban ngày, khi chúng đang nhìn, con hãy đem đồ đạc ra như đồ đạc đã gói sẵn để đi lưu đày. Rồi đến chiều, khi chúng đang nhìn, chính con hãy đi ra như những người bị đưa đi lưu đày.
vi.R: Ban ngày, khi chúng đang nhìn, con hãy đem đồ đạc đã gói sẵn ra như sắp đi lưu đày. Rồi buổi chiều, khi chúng đang nhìn, con hãy ra đi như một tù binh bị dẫn đi.

am.L: ጓዝህንም እንደ ስደት ጓዝ በቀን በዓይናቸው ፊት አውጣ፤ አንተም ወደ ስደት እንደሚወጡ ሰዎች በማታ በዓይናቸው ፊት ውጣ።
am.B: እያዩህ በቀን ጓዝህን ለስደት እንደ ተዘጋጀ ጓዝ አውጣ። ከዚያም ማታ እያዩህ ወደ ስደት እንደሚሄዱ ሰዎች አንተ ራስህ ውጣ።
am.R: በቀን እያዩህ ለስደት እንደ ተዘጋጀ ጓዝህን አውጣ። ከዚያም ማታ እያዩህ እንደ ተማረከ ሰው ውጣ።

hi.L: और तुम दिन को उनकी आँखों के सामने अपना सामान बंधुआई के सामान के समान बाहर निकालना; और तुम आप साँझ को उनकी आँखों के सामने ऐसे निकलना जैसे बंधुआई में जानेवाले निकलते हैं।
hi.B: दिन में, उनके देखते हुए, अपना सामान बाहर निकालो, जैसे बंधुआई के लिए बाँधा गया सामान हो। फिर साँझ को, उनके देखते हुए, तुम स्वयं ऐसे निकलो जैसे लोग बंधुआई में जाते हैं।
hi.R: दिन के समय, जब वे देख रहे हों, अपना सामान ऐसे बाहर लाओ मानो बंधुआई के लिए बाँधा हो। फिर साँझ को, जब वे देख रहे हों, ऐसे निकल जाओ जैसे कोई बंदी ले जाया जाता है।

ru.L: И вынеси свои вещи, как вещи изгнанника, днём у них на глазах; а сам выйди вечером у них на глазах, как выходят в изгнание.
ru.B: Днём, у них на глазах, вынеси свои вещи, как вещи, собранные для изгнания. А вечером, у них на глазах, выйди сам, как люди, которых уводят в изгнание.
ru.R: Днём, когда они будут смотреть, вынеси свои вещи, собранные как будто для изгнания. А вечером, когда они будут смотреть, уходи, как пленник, которого уводят.

ja.L: あなたは昼間、彼らの目の前で、あなたの荷物を捕囚の荷物のように運び出しなさい。そしてあなた自身は夕方、彼らの目の前で、捕囚として出て行く者のように出て行きなさい。
ja.B: 昼間、彼らが見ている前で、捕囚のためにまとめた荷物のように、あなたの荷物を運び出しなさい。そして夕方、彼らが見ている前で、捕囚として連れて行かれる人々のように、あなた自身が出て行きなさい。
ja.R: 昼のうちに、彼らが見ている前で、捕虜として連れて行かれる人のようにまとめた荷物を運び出しなさい。そして夕方、彼らが見ている前で、連れて行かれる捕虜のように出て行きなさい。

decisions.choice: by day, the baggage; in the evening, the man himself
decisions.reason: The bundle goes out in daylight so that all can see it; Ezekiel himself leaves at dusk, as people fleeing or being led away would leave (12:12).

decisions.choice: By day the baggage, in the evening the man himself, each in its own sentence at every level.
decisions.reason: The two stages of the sign (m1).

source.text: לְעֵינֵיהֶ֖ם חֲתָר־לְךָ֣ בַקִּ֑יר וְהוֹצֵאתָ֖ בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: In their sight dig for yourself through the wall, and bring out through it.

en.L: Before their eyes dig for yourself through the wall, and bring [it] out through it.
en.B: As they look on, dig a hole in the wall and take your belongings out through it.
en.R: While they are watching, dig a hole through the wall of your house and carry your things out through it.

pt.L: Diante dos olhos deles, cava para ti através da parede, e tira [a bagagem] por ali.
pt.B: Enquanto eles olham, abre um buraco na parede e tira por ele os teus pertences.
pt.R: Enquanto eles estão olhando, cava um buraco na parede da tua casa e leva as tuas coisas para fora por ele.

es.L: Ante sus ojos ábrete paso a través de la pared, y saca [el equipaje] por ella.
es.B: Mientras ellos miran, abre un boquete en la pared y saca tus cosas por él.
es.R: Mientras te miran, abre un agujero en la pared de tu casa y saca tus cosas por ahí.

sw.L: Mbele ya macho yao jitobolee ukuta, utoe [mizigo] kupitia huo.
sw.B: Wakiwa wanaangalia, toboa shimo ukutani, utoe mizigo yako kupitia shimo hilo.
sw.R: Wakiwa wanatazama, toboa shimo kwenye ukuta wa nyumba yako, utoe vitu vyako kupitia shimo hilo.

ko.L: 그들의 눈앞에서 너를 위하여 벽을 뚫고, 그리로 [짐을] 내어 가거라.
ko.B: 그들이 보는 앞에서 벽에 구멍을 뚫고, 그 구멍으로 네 짐을 내어 가거라.
ko.R: 그들이 지켜보는 동안 네 집 벽에 구멍을 뚫고, 그 구멍으로 짐을 가지고 나가거라.

fr.L: Sous leurs yeux, creuse-toi [un passage] à travers le mur, et fais sortir [tes affaires] par là.
fr.B: Sous leurs regards, perce un trou dans le mur et fais sortir tes affaires par cette ouverture.
fr.R: Pendant qu’ils regardent, creuse un trou dans le mur de ta maison et sors tes affaires par ce trou.

vi.L: Trước mắt chúng, ngươi hãy đào cho mình xuyên qua bức tường, và đem [đồ] ra qua đó.
vi.B: Trong khi chúng nhìn, con hãy đục một lỗ trên tường rồi đem đồ đạc ra qua lỗ ấy.
vi.R: Trong khi chúng đang nhìn, con hãy đục một lỗ xuyên qua tường nhà mình và mang đồ đạc ra qua lỗ ấy.

am.L: በዓይናቸው ፊት ግድግዳውን ለራስህ ንደል፤ በእርሱም በኩል [ጓዝህን] አውጣ።
am.B: እያዩህ ግድግዳውን ነድለህ ጓዝህን በእርሱ በኩል አውጣ።
am.R: እያዩህ የቤትህን ግድግዳ ነድለህ ጓዝህን በቀዳዳው በኩል አውጣ።

hi.L: उनकी आँखों के सामने अपने लिए दीवार में सेंध लगाना, और उसी में से [सामान] बाहर निकालना।
hi.B: उनके देखते-देखते दीवार में छेद करो और उसी में से अपना सामान बाहर निकालो।
hi.R: जब वे देख रहे हों, तब अपने घर की दीवार में छेद करो और अपना सामान उसमें से बाहर ले जाओ।

ru.L: У них на глазах проломай себе стену и выноси через неё.
ru.B: У них на глазах проделай пролом в стене и вынеси через него свои вещи.
ru.R: Когда они будут смотреть, проделай дыру в стене своего дома и вынеси через неё свои вещи.

ja.L: 彼らの目の前で、あなたは自分のために壁に穴を掘り、そこから運び出しなさい。
ja.B: 彼らが見ている前で壁に穴を掘り、そこから荷物を運び出しなさい。
ja.R: 彼らが見ている前で、家の壁に穴を掘りなさい。そして、そこから荷物を運び出しなさい。

decisions.choice: dig through the wall: the wall of his house, made of mud brick
decisions.reason: Houses in Babylonia were built of mud brick, which could be dug through by hand (compare Job 24:16). The act pictures people escaping from a city by a hole in the wall, as the king will do (12:12).

decisions.choice: the wall of your house
decisions.reason: Readable says which wall is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: chator beqir "壁に穴を掘り" at every level (R "家の壁", as the English R).
decisions.reason: The wall of his house, of mud brick (m1).

source.text: לְעֵ֨ינֵיהֶ֜ם עַל־כָּתֵ֤ף תִּשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה תוֹצִ֔יא פָּנֶ֣יךָ תְכַסֶּ֔ה וְלֹ֥א תִרְאֶ֖ה אֶת־הָאָ֑רֶץ כִּֽי־מוֹפֵ֥ת נְתַתִּ֖יךָ לְבֵ֥ית יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: In their sight on [the] shoulder you shall lift, in the darkness bring out; your face you shall cover, and not see the land; for a sign I have made you to [the] house of Israel.

en.L: Before their eyes you shall lift [it] onto [your] shoulder; in the dark you shall carry [it] out. You shall cover your face so that you do not see the land, for a sign I have made you to the house of Israel.
en.B: While they watch, lift the bundle onto your shoulder and carry it out in the dark. Cover your face so that you do not see the land, for I have made you a sign for the house of Israel.
en.R: While they are watching, put your bundle on your shoulder and carry it out in the dark. Cover your face so that you cannot see the land. I have made you a sign to warn the people of Israel.

pt.L: Diante dos olhos deles, [a] porás sobre [o] ombro; na escuridão [a] levarás para fora. Cobrirás o teu rosto para que não vejas a terra, pois eu te fiz um sinal para a casa de Israel.
pt.B: Enquanto eles olham, põe a trouxa no ombro e leva-a para fora no escuro. Cobre o rosto para não veres a terra, pois eu te fiz um sinal para a casa de Israel.
pt.R: Enquanto eles estão olhando, põe a tua trouxa no ombro e leva-a para fora no escuro. Cobre o rosto para não poderes ver a terra. Eu te fiz um sinal para avisar o povo de Israel.

es.L: Ante sus ojos [lo] alzarás sobre [tu] hombro; en la oscuridad [lo] sacarás. Te cubrirás el rostro para que no veas la tierra, porque por señal te he puesto para la casa de Israel.
es.B: Mientras ellos miran, échate el bulto al hombro y sácalo en la oscuridad. Cúbrete el rostro para no ver la tierra, porque te he puesto como señal para la casa de Israel.
es.R: Mientras te miran, ponte el bulto al hombro y sácalo en la oscuridad. Cúbrete la cara para que no puedas ver la tierra. Te he puesto como una señal de advertencia para el pueblo de Israel.

sw.L: Mbele ya macho yao utaubeba [mzigo] begani; gizani utautoa. Utafunika uso wako usiione nchi, kwa maana nimekufanya kuwa ishara kwa nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.B: Wakiwa wanatazama, weka mzigo wako begani na uutoe nje gizani. Funika uso wako usiione nchi, kwa maana nimekufanya kuwa ishara kwa nyumba ya Israeli.
sw.R: Wakiwa wanatazama, weka mzigo wako begani uubebe nje gizani. Funika uso wako ili usiweze kuiona nchi. Nimekufanya kuwa ishara ya kuwaonya watu wa Israeli.

ko.L: 그들의 눈앞에서 [그것을] 어깨에 메고, 어둠 속에서 [그것을] 내어 가거라. 네 얼굴을 가려 그 땅을 보지 마라. 내가 너를 이스라엘 집에 표징으로 삼았기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들이 보는 앞에서 그 짐을 어깨에 메고 어두울 때 내어 가거라. 얼굴을 가려서 땅을 보지 못하게 하여라. 내가 너를 이스라엘 집에 표징으로 세웠기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그들이 지켜보는 동안 짐을 어깨에 메고 어두울 때 가지고 나가거라. 얼굴을 가려서 땅을 볼 수 없게 하여라. 내가 너를 이스라엘 백성에게 경고하는 표징으로 삼았다.

fr.L: Sous leurs yeux, tu [les] porteras sur [ton] épaule ; dans l’obscurité tu [les] sortiras. Tu couvriras ta face, et tu ne verras pas le pays, car je t’ai établi [comme] signe pour la maison d’Israël.
fr.B: Sous leurs yeux, charge le ballot sur ton épaule et emporte-le dans l’obscurité. Couvre-toi le visage pour ne pas voir le pays, car j’ai fait de toi un signe pour la maison d’Israël.
fr.R: Pendant qu’ils regardent, mets ton ballot sur ton épaule et emporte-le dans le noir. Couvre-toi le visage pour ne pas voir le pays. J’ai fait de toi un signe pour avertir le peuple d’Israël.

vi.L: Trước mắt chúng, ngươi hãy vác [nó] lên vai; trong bóng tối ngươi hãy đem [nó] ra. Ngươi hãy che mặt mình để không thấy đất, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt ngươi làm dấu hiệu cho nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Trong khi chúng nhìn, con hãy vác gói đồ lên vai và đem ra trong bóng tối. Hãy che mặt lại để con không nhìn thấy xứ, vì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã đặt con làm dấu hiệu cho nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Trong khi chúng đang nhìn, con hãy đặt gói đồ lên vai và mang ra ngoài trong bóng tối. Hãy che mặt lại để con không thấy được xứ. Ta đã đặt con làm dấu hiệu để cảnh báo dân Y-sơ-ra-ên.

am.L: በዓይናቸው ፊት በትከሻ ላይ ተሸከም፤ በጨለማም አውጣ፤ ምድሪቱንም እንዳታይ ፊትህን ሸፍን፤ ለእስራኤል ቤት ምልክት አድርጌሃለሁና።
am.B: እያዩህ ጓዙን በትከሻህ ተሸክመህ በጨለማ አውጣው። ምድሪቱን እንዳታይ ፊትህን ሸፍን፤ ለእስራኤል ቤት ምልክት አድርጌሃለሁና።
am.R: እያዩህ ጓዝህን በትከሻህ ተሸክመህ በጨለማ ውጣ። ምድሪቱን እንዳታይ ፊትህን ሸፍን። የእስራኤልን ሕዝብ እንድታስጠነቅቅ ምልክት አድርጌሃለሁ።

hi.L: उनकी आँखों के सामने तुम [उसे अपने] कंधे पर उठाना; अँधेरे में [उसे] बाहर ले जाना। अपना मुँह ढाँप लेना कि तुम देश को न देखो; क्योंकि मैंने तुम्हें इस्राएल के घराने के लिए एक चिह्न ठहराया है।
hi.B: उनके देखते हुए गठरी को कंधे पर उठाओ और अँधेरे में बाहर ले जाओ। अपना मुँह ढाँप लो कि तुम देश को न देखो, क्योंकि मैंने तुम्हें इस्राएल के घराने के लिए एक चिह्न ठहराया है।
hi.R: जब वे देख रहे हों, तब अपनी गठरी कंधे पर रखो और अँधेरे में उसे बाहर ले जाओ। अपना मुँह ढक लो ताकि तुम देश को न देख सको। मैंने तुम्हें इस्राएल के लोगों को चेतावनी देने के लिए एक चिह्न बनाया है।

ru.L: У них на глазах на плечо подними [их], в темноте вынеси; лицо своё закрой, чтобы не видеть земли, ведь знамением {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал тебя для дома Израиля.
ru.B: У них на глазах подними узел на плечо и вынеси его в темноте. Закрой лицо, чтобы не видеть земли, ведь {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сделал тебя знамением для дома Израиля.
ru.R: Когда они будут смотреть, положи узел на плечо и вынеси его в темноте. Закрой лицо, чтобы не видеть земли. Я сделал тебя знаком, чтобы предостеречь народ Израиля.

ja.L: 彼らの目の前で、あなたは[それを]肩に担ぎ、暗闇の中で運び出しなさい。あなたは顔を覆って、地を見ないようにしなさい。わたしはあなたを、イスラエルの家へのしるしとしたからである。
ja.B: 彼らが見ている前で、荷物を肩に担ぎ、暗闇の中で運び出しなさい。顔を覆って、地を見ないようにしなさい。わたしはあなたを、イスラエルの家のためのしるしとしたからだ。
ja.R: 彼らが見ている前で、荷物を肩に担いで、暗い中を運び出しなさい。顔を覆って、この地を見ないようにしなさい。わたしはあなたを、イスラエルの人々に警告するためのしるしとしたのだ。

decisions.choice: a sign: an act that points to what will happen
decisions.reason: The word is used for a sign or portent, a person or deed that shows ahead of time what God will do (24:24, 27; Isaiah 8:18; 20:3).

decisions.choice: cover your face so that you do not see the land: the grief and shame of leaving, and the king's fate
decisions.reason: Covering the face is a sign of mourning and shame (2 Samuel 15:30; 19:5). It also looks ahead to the king who "will not see the land" (12:12-13).

decisions.choice: a sign to warn
decisions.reason: Readable says what the sign is for.

decisions.choice: "la casa de Israel" (L, B); "el pueblo de Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets it for Ezekiel, kept wherever the phrase returns.

decisions.choice: "표징" for mofet (a sign acted out), at every level
decisions.reason: 표징 is the word of the published Isaiah 20:3 and 8:18 for the prophet as a sign; 징조 there renders the companion word 'ot.

decisions.choice: "dấu hiệu"
decisions.reason: 'Ot here is an act that points to what will happen, not a miracle; "dấu hiệu" as Isaiah 19:20 and 37:30. "Dấu lạ" is kept for miraculous signs.

decisions.choice: चिह्न
decisions.reason: A sign is चिह्न at every level, the word used for signs in this translation; Ezekiel's acted signs point to what will happen (m1).

decisions.choice: знамение (L, B); знак (R)
decisions.reason: The word for a sign that points to what will happen (m1), as the New Testament's "знамение" (L, B) and "знак" (R).

decisions.choice: mofet "しるし" at every level (as 'ot in 4:3), R "警告するためのしるし" as the English R; "顔を覆って、地を見ないように".
decisions.reason: An act that points to what will happen (m1); covering the face shows grief and points to the king's fate (m2, uncertain).

records.literal_gloss: And I did so, as I had been commanded; my baggage I brought out like baggage of exile by day, and in the evening I dug for myself through the wall with [the] hand; in the darkness I brought out; on [the] shoulder I carried in their sight.

en.L: And I did so, as I had been commanded. My baggage I brought out like an exile's baggage by day, and in the evening I dug for myself through the wall with [my] hand; in the dark I brought [it] out; on [my] shoulder I carried [it] before their eyes.
en.B: So I did as I was commanded. By day I brought out my belongings as if packed for exile, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. I took them out in the dark, carrying them on my shoulder while they watched.
en.R: So I did what I was told. During the day I brought out my things packed as if for exile. In the evening I dug through the wall with my hands. Then I went out in the dark, carrying my bundle on my shoulder while the people watched.

pt.L: E fiz assim, como me fora ordenado. A minha bagagem tirei como bagagem de exilado, de dia, e à tarde cavei para mim através da parede com [a] mão; na escuridão [a] tirei; sobre [o] ombro [a] carreguei diante dos olhos deles.
pt.B: Então fiz como me foi ordenado. De dia tirei os meus pertences, como se estivessem arrumados para o exílio, e à tarde cavei a parede com as mãos. Tirei-os no escuro, carregando-os no ombro enquanto eles olhavam.
pt.R: Então fiz o que me foi mandado. Durante o dia, tirei para fora as minhas coisas arrumadas como para o exílio. À tarde, cavei a parede com as mãos. Depois saí no escuro, carregando a minha trouxa no ombro enquanto o povo olhava.

es.L: E hice así, como se me había mandado. Mi equipaje saqué como equipaje de destierro, de día, y por la tarde me abrí paso a través de la pared con [la] mano; en la oscuridad [lo] saqué; sobre [el] hombro [lo] cargué ante sus ojos.
es.B: Así que hice lo que se me había mandado. De día saqué mis cosas como equipaje preparado para el destierro, y por la tarde abrí un boquete en la pared con las manos. Las saqué en la oscuridad y las llevé al hombro mientras ellos miraban.
es.R: Así que hice lo que se me dijo. Durante el día saqué mis cosas empacadas como para ir al destierro. Por la tarde abrí un agujero en la pared con las manos. Luego salí en la oscuridad, con mi bulto al hombro, mientras la gente miraba.

sw.L: Nami nikafanya hivyo, kama nilivyoamriwa. Mizigo yangu nikaitoa kama mizigo ya uhamisho mchana, na jioni nikajitobolea ukuta kwa mkono; gizani nikaitoa, begani nikaibeba mbele ya macho yao.
sw.B: Basi nilifanya kama nilivyoamriwa. Mchana nikatoa mizigo yangu kana kwamba imefungwa kwa ajili ya uhamisho, na jioni nikatoboa ukuta kwa mikono yangu. Nikaitoa gizani, nikaibeba begani wakiwa wanatazama.
sw.R: Basi nilifanya kama nilivyoambiwa. Wakati wa mchana nikatoa vitu vyangu vilivyofungwa kana kwamba ninakwenda uhamishoni. Jioni nikatoboa ukuta kwa mikono yangu. Kisha nikatoka gizani nikiwa nimebeba mzigo wangu begani, watu wakiwa wanatazama.

ko.L: 그래서 나는 명령을 받은 대로 그렇게 했다. 낮에는 내 짐을 포로의 짐처럼 내어 놓았고, 저녁에는 손으로 벽을 뚫었다. 어둠 속에서 [짐을] 내어 가고, 그들의 눈앞에서 어깨에 메었다.
ko.B: 그래서 나는 명령을 받은 대로 했다. 낮에는 포로로 끌려갈 때 꾸린 짐처럼 내 짐을 내놓았고, 저녁에는 손으로 벽을 뚫었다. 그리고 어두울 때 그들이 보는 앞에서 짐을 어깨에 메고 나갔다.
ko.R: 그래서 나는 들은 대로 했다. 낮에는 포로로 끌려갈 때처럼 싼 짐을 밖으로 내놓았다. 저녁에는 손으로 벽에 구멍을 뚫었다. 그리고 어두울 때 사람들이 지켜보는 가운데 짐을 어깨에 메고 나갔다.

fr.L: Et je fis ainsi, comme il m’avait été ordonné. Mon bagage, je le sortis comme un bagage d’exil, de jour, et le soir je me creusai [un passage] à travers le mur avec la main ; dans l’obscurité je [le] sortis ; sur [mon] épaule je [le] portai sous leurs yeux.
fr.B: Je fis donc comme on me l’avait ordonné. De jour, je sortis mes affaires comme des affaires préparées pour l’exil, et le soir je perçai le mur avec mes mains. Je les emportai dans l’obscurité, chargées sur mon épaule, sous leurs yeux.
fr.R: J’ai donc fait ce qu’on m’avait dit. Pendant la journée, j’ai sorti mes affaires préparées comme pour l’exil. Le soir, j’ai creusé un trou dans le mur avec mes mains. Puis je suis parti dans le noir, mon ballot sur l’épaule, pendant que les gens regardaient.
