decisions.choice: the prince is this oracle: a play on "oracle" and "burden"
alternatives: this burden is the prince, the load Ezekiel carried
decisions.reason: The word for "oracle" also means "burden", something lifted and carried; both come from the verb "to lift". The words "the prince" and "the oracle" sound alike. The bundle Ezekiel lifted onto his shoulder (12:6-7) stands for the prince, who will lift his own load and go out (12:12). The plain sense is that the oracle concerns him; the pun makes him the burden itself.

decisions.choice: the prince in Jerusalem: King Zedekiah
decisions.reason: The ruler in Jerusalem at this time was Zedekiah, made king by Nebuchadnezzar in 597 BC (2 Kings 24:17). Ezekiel calls him "prince", not "king", perhaps because the exiled Jehoiachin was still counted as king (1:2; 17:12-13). The verses that follow describe Zedekiah's flight and capture.

decisions.choice: prince (L, B), ruler (R); oracle (L, B), message (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for these words in the prophets and in Ezekiel. Literal keeps the bare Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give its plain sense (m1).

decisions.choice: o príncipe (L, B), o governante (R); oráculo (L), mensagem (B, R)
decisions.reason: Massa' (m1) takes the wording Isaiah 13:1 sets for the whole of the prophets in Portuguese, "oráculo" at Literal and "mensagem" at Balanced and Readable, where the English Balanced keeps "oracle"; Brazilian readers know "oráculo" mostly from pagan shrines. The sound play of nasi' and massa', and the double sense "burden" that links the word to the bundle on Ezekiel's shoulder, cannot be kept in Portuguese and are left to the meaning note. Nasi' follows 7:27.

decisions.choice: "Así dice el Señor DIOS:" (L); "El Señor DIOS dice esto:" (B); "Esto es lo que dice el Señor DIOS:" (R)
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH is "el Señor" with the divine_name span on "DIOS", the article outside the span, and the messenger formula is worded as in Isaiah and Jeremiah. The message Ezekiel is told to deliver takes no quotation marks, as in the English.

decisions.choice: "príncipe" (L, B), "gobernante" (R); "oráculo" (L, B), "mensaje" (R)
decisions.reason: Nasi as the terms note sets it for Ezekiel; massa as in Isaiah. Literal keeps the bare wording behind the play on "oracle" and "burden".

decisions.choice: "Bwana MUNGU asema hivi:" (L); "Hivi ndivyo Bwana MUNGU asemavyo:" (B); "Hili ndilo Bwana MUNGU analosema:" (R), with "Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}}" for the Lord GOD
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as the Swahili Isaiah and Jeremiah word it, with "Kwa hiyo" in front where the Hebrew has "therefore". "The Lord GOD" (Adonai YHWH) is "Bwana MUNGU" at every level, with the reader setting on MUNGU only. Used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "mkuu" (L, B), "mtawala" (R); "unabii" (L, B), "ujumbe" (R)
decisions.reason: The prince (nasi') is "mkuu", and Readable says "mtawala" (ruler), as the English. Literal brackets "ni juu ya" (is about), since Swahili cannot say "the prince is this oracle"; the meaning decision explains the play on words.

decisions.choice: "주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이와 같이 말씀하신다" (L), "…이렇게 말씀하신다" (B), "…께서 하시는 말씀이다" (R) for "Thus says the Lord GOD", ending in a period
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording. Lord GOD (Adonai YHWH) is 주 with the span {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}; since 하나님 ends in a consonant and 야훼 in a vowel, only particles that fit both (께서, 의, 인, 이다) follow the span. The formula keeps 께서 and -시- even in God's own mouth, as the published Kings and Isaiah do.

decisions.choice: "군주" (L, B), "통치자" (R) for the prince (nasi'); "신탁" (L, B), "말씀" (R) for the oracle (massa)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's words. Korean cannot keep the Hebrew play of nasi' and massa' ("burden"); the shared footnote explains it.

decisions.choice: ’Ainsi parle le Seigneur DIEU :’ (L); ’Le Seigneur DIEU dit ceci :’ (B); ’Voici ce que dit le Seigneur DIEU :’ (R), with no quotation marks around the message Ezekiel is told to deliver, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The prophetic formula as Isaiah and Jeremiah word it, with ’le Seigneur DIEU’ for Adonai YHWH and only ’DIEU’ under the setting. As in the English, God’s oracle and the message the prophet is to speak take no quotation marks; speech quoted inside them does (’« Que fais-tu ? »’, 12:9).

decisions.choice: ’prince’ (L, B), ’chef’ (R) for nasi; ’oracle’ (L, B), ’message’ (R) for massa
decisions.reason: As the English and the book’s term list. The play on massa as ’oracle’ and ’burden’ is explained in the English footnote; French ’oracle’ keeps the sense the sentence needs.

decisions.choice: "Chúa là CHÚA phán thế này:" (L); "Chúa là CHÚA phán như vầy:" (B); "Đây là lời Chúa là CHÚA phán:" (R)
decisions.reason: Adonai YHWH is "Chúa là CHÚA" at every level, with "Chúa" plain and only CHÚA in the divine-name span, as Isaiah 28:16; the formula takes the terms note's three wordings and no quotation marks. "Declares the Lord GOD" is "Chúa là CHÚA phán vậy" (L, B) / "Chúa là CHÚA phán" (R). Used unchanged through these chapters.

decisions.choice: nasi': "thủ lĩnh" (L, B); "người cai trị" (R); massa': "sấm ngôn" (L, B); "sứ điệp" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's words. Literal keeps the Hebrew's terse "the prince [is] this oracle", so the play the footnote explains stays visible.

decisions.choice: nasiʾ "ገዥ" at every level; massa "የትንቢት ቃል" (L, B), "መልእክት" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel calls the king "the prince"; "ገዥ" (plural "ገዦች") is used for nasiʾ through Ezekiel, as in chapters 44-48, and keeps the title apart from "ንጉሥ" and from "አለቆች" (the officials, sarim). "መስፍን" is not used, since on main it is the word for the judges. The pun of the Hebrew ("the prince is this burden") cannot be kept; Literal keeps the bare sentence.

decisions.choice: प्रधान (L, B), शासक (R); भारी वचन (L), संदेश (B, R)
decisions.reason: The prince (nasi, King Zedekiah, m2) is प्रधान at Literal and Balanced, शासक at Readable; राजकुमार would suggest a king's son. The oracle (massa) takes the prophets note's forms. Literal keeps the bare phrase, bracketing what Hindi needs.

decisions.choice: князь (L, B), правитель (R); пророчество (L, B), весть (R)
decisions.reason: "Князь" for the nasi, Ezekiel's word for the king; "пророчество" and "весть" for massa, as the prophets note. Literal keeps the bare Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable give its sense (m1).

decisions.choice: nasi' "君主" (L, B), "指導者" (R), as notes/EZK-EZK-1.md; hammassa' "託宣" (L, B), "お告げ" (R), as Isaiah; the Literal keeps the abrupt Hebrew with brackets.
decisions.reason: The verse plays on massa' as 'oracle' and 'burden' (m1, footnoted), not imitated; the prince is Zedekiah (m2), not named in the text.

source.text: אֱמֹ֖ר אֲנִ֣י מֽוֹפֶתְכֶ֑ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֗יתִי כֵּ֚ן יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה לָהֶ֔ם בַּגּוֹלָ֥ה בַשְּׁבִ֖י יֵלֵֽכוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Say, I [am] your sign; as I have done, so it will be done to them; into exile, into captivity they will go.

en.L: Say, I [am] your sign; as I have done, so it will be done to them; into exile, into captivity they will go.
en.B: Say: I am a sign for you. As I have done, so it will be done to them. They will go into exile, into captivity.
en.R: Tell them: I am a sign for you. What I have done will happen to them. They will be taken away as captives into exile.

pt.L: Dize: Eu [sou] o sinal de vocês; como eu fiz, assim se fará a eles; para o exílio, para o cativeiro irão.
pt.B: Dize: Eu sou um sinal para vocês. Como eu fiz, assim será feito a eles. Irão para o exílio, para o cativeiro.
pt.R: Diz a eles: Eu sou um sinal para vocês. O que eu fiz vai acontecer com eles. Eles vão ser levados como prisioneiros para o exílio.

es.L: Di: Yo [soy] {{plural_you:su señal|vuestra señal}}; como yo he hecho, así se hará con ellos; al destierro, a la cautividad irán.
es.B: Di: Yo soy una señal para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Lo que yo he hecho, eso mismo se hará con ellos. Irán al destierro, a la cautividad.
es.R: Diles: Yo soy una señal para {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}}. Lo que yo he hecho les pasará a ellos. Se los llevarán cautivos al destierro.

sw.L: Sema, Mimi [ni] ishara yenu; kama nilivyofanya, ndivyo watakavyotendewa; uhamishoni, utumwani watakwenda.
sw.B: Sema: Mimi ni ishara kwenu. Kama nilivyofanya, ndivyo watakavyotendewa. Watakwenda uhamishoni, utumwani.
sw.R: Waambie: Mimi ni ishara kwenu. Yale niliyoyafanya yatawapata wao. Watachukuliwa mateka kwenda uhamishoni.

ko.L: 말하여라. 나는 여러분의 표징이오. 내가 한 것처럼 그들에게도 그렇게 될 것이오. 그들은 포로가 되어 사로잡혀 갈 것이오.
ko.B: 이렇게 말하여라. 나는 여러분에게 주어진 표징이오. 내가 한 그대로 그들도 당할 것이오. 그들은 사로잡혀 포로로 끌려갈 것이오.
ko.R: 그들에게 말하여라. 나는 여러분에게 보여 주는 표징이오. 내가 한 일이 그들에게 그대로 일어날 것이오. 그들은 포로로 사로잡혀 끌려갈 것이오.

fr.L: Dis : Moi, [je suis] votre signe ; comme j’ai fait, ainsi il leur sera fait ; en exil, en captivité ils iront.
fr.B: Dis : Je suis un signe pour vous. Ce que j’ai fait, c’est ce qu’on leur fera. Ils iront en exil, en captivité.
fr.R: Dis-leur : Je suis un signe pour vous. Ce que j’ai fait va leur arriver. Ils seront emmenés en exil comme prisonniers.

vi.L: Hãy nói: Tôi [là] dấu hiệu cho các người; tôi đã làm thế nào, thì chúng sẽ bị làm cho như thế; chúng sẽ đi lưu đày, đi vào cảnh phu tù.
vi.B: Hãy nói: Tôi là dấu hiệu cho các người. Tôi đã làm thế nào, thì chúng cũng sẽ bị như vậy. Chúng sẽ bị lưu đày, bị bắt làm phu tù.
vi.R: Hãy nói với chúng: Tôi là dấu hiệu cho các người. Điều tôi đã làm sẽ xảy đến cho chúng. Chúng sẽ bị bắt làm tù binh và bị đưa đi lưu đày.

am.L: እንዲህ በል፦ እኔ ምልክታችሁ [ነኝ]፤ እኔ እንዳደረግኩ እንዲሁ ይደረግባቸዋል፤ ወደ ስደት፣ ወደ ምርኮ ይሄዳሉ።
am.B: እንዲህ በል፦ እኔ ለእናንተ ምልክት ነኝ። እኔ እንዳደረግኩ እንዲሁ ይደረግባቸዋል። ወደ ስደትና ወደ ምርኮ ይሄዳሉ።
am.R: እንዲህ በላቸው፦ እኔ ለእናንተ ምልክት ነኝ። እኔ ያደረግኩት በእነርሱ ላይ ይደርሳል። ተማርከው ወደ ስደት ይወሰዳሉ።

hi.L: कहो, मैं तुम्हारे लिए चिह्न [हूँ]; जैसा मैंने किया है, वैसा ही उनके साथ किया जाएगा; वे बंधुआई में, क़ैद में जाएँगे।
hi.B: कहो: मैं तुम्हारे लिए एक चिह्न हूँ। जैसा मैंने किया है, वैसा ही उनके साथ किया जाएगा। वे बंधुआई में, क़ैद में जाएँगे।
hi.R: उनसे कहो: मैं तुम्हारे लिए एक चिह्न हूँ। जो मैंने किया है, वही उनके साथ होगा। वे बंदी बनाकर बंधुआई में ले जाए जाएँगे।

ru.L: Скажи: Я — ваше знамение; как я сделал, так будет сделано с ними; в изгнание, в плен пойдут они.
ru.B: Скажи: Я — знамение для вас. Как я сделал, так будет сделано и с ними. Они пойдут в изгнание, в плен.
ru.R: Скажи им: Я — знак для вас. Что я сделал, то и случится с ними. Их уведут в плен, в изгнание.

ja.L: 言いなさい。わたしはあなたがたのしるしである。わたしが行ったように、そのように彼らに行われる。彼らは捕囚となり、捕らわれの身となって行く。
ja.B: 言いなさい。わたしはあなたがたのためのしるしである。わたしがしたとおりのことが、彼らに起こる。彼らは捕囚となって、捕らわれて行く。
ja.R: こう言いなさい。わたしは、あなたたちのためのしるしだ。わたしがしたことが、彼らに起こる。彼らは、捕虜として、ほかの国へ連れて行かれる。

decisions.choice: I am your sign: Ezekiel himself is the message
decisions.reason: Ezekiel speaks in his own name here. What he has acted out shows what will be done to the people of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: Ezekiel speaks to the exiles in his own voice in 하오체 with 여러분 ("나는 여러분의 표징이오")
decisions.reason: The term sheet's register for the prophet addressing the people in his own person, as Jeremiah 42:4, 9; God's oracles that he passes on stay 해라체. Here God gives him the words, but the 'I' is Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: Ezekiel to the people: "tôi" and "các người"
decisions.reason: As the terms note's prophet speaking to the people in rebuke: "các người", not God's "các ngươi", since here Ezekiel speaks in his own voice.

decisions.choice: 'ani moftekhem "わたしはあなたがたのしるしである" (L), "…のためのしるし" (B, R): Ezekiel speaks of himself.
decisions.reason: Ezekiel himself is the message (m1).

source.text: וְהַנָּשִׂ֨יא אֲשֶׁר־בְּתוֹכָ֜ם אֶל־כָּתֵ֤ף יִשָּׂא֙ בָּעֲלָטָ֣ה וְיֵצֵ֔א בַּקִּ֥יר יַחְתְּר֖וּ לְה֣וֹצִיא ב֑וֹ פָּנָ֣יו יְכַסֶּ֔ה יַ֗עַן אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא־יִרְאֶ֥ה לַעַ֛יִןה֖וּא אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the prince who [is] in their midst on [the] shoulder will lift in the darkness and go out; through the wall they will dig to bring out through it; his face he will cover, so that not he will see with [the] eye the land.

en.L: And the prince who [is] among them will lift [his load] onto [his] shoulder in the dark and go out; through the wall they will dig to bring [him] out by it; he will cover his face, so that he may not see the land with [his] eye.
en.B: The prince among them will lift his bundle onto his shoulder in the dark and go out. They will dig through the wall to get him out through it. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land with his eyes.
en.R: The ruler of the people will put his bundle on his shoulder and leave in the dark. A hole will be dug through the wall to get him out. He will cover his face so that he cannot see the land.

pt.L: E o príncipe que [está] no meio deles porá [a carga] sobre [o] ombro na escuridão e sairá; através da parede cavarão para tirá-[lo] por ela; ele cobrirá o seu rosto, para que não veja a terra com [o] olho.
pt.B: O príncipe que está no meio deles porá a sua trouxa no ombro no escuro e sairá. Cavarão a parede para tirá-lo por ela. Ele cobrirá o rosto para não ver a terra com os seus olhos.
pt.R: O governante do povo vai pôr a sua trouxa no ombro e sair no escuro. Vai ser aberto um buraco na parede para tirá-lo dali. Ele vai cobrir o rosto para não ver a terra.

es.L: Y el príncipe que [está] en medio de ellos alzará [su carga] sobre [el] hombro en la oscuridad y saldrá; por la pared cavarán para sacar[lo] por ella; se cubrirá el rostro para no ver con [su] ojo la tierra.
es.B: El príncipe que está entre ellos se echará el bulto al hombro en la oscuridad y saldrá. Abrirán un boquete en la pared para sacarlo por él. Se cubrirá el rostro para no ver la tierra con sus ojos.
es.R: El gobernante del pueblo se pondrá el bulto al hombro y saldrá en la oscuridad. Se abrirá un agujero en la pared para sacarlo por ahí. Se cubrirá la cara para no ver la tierra.

sw.L: Na mkuu aliye katikati yao atabeba [mzigo] begani gizani na kutoka; watatoboa ukuta ili kumtoa kupitia huo; atafunika uso wake, ili asiione nchi kwa jicho lake.
sw.B: Mkuu aliye kati yao ataweka mzigo wake begani gizani na kutoka. Watatoboa ukuta ili kumtoa kupitia huo. Atafunika uso wake ili asiweze kuiona nchi kwa macho yake.
sw.R: Mtawala wa watu ataweka mzigo wake begani na kuondoka gizani. Shimo litatobolewa ukutani ili kumtoa nje. Atafunika uso wake ili asiweze kuiona nchi.

ko.L: 그들 가운데 있는 군주는 어둠 속에서 [짐을] 어깨에 메고 나갈 것이다. 그들이 벽을 뚫고 그리로 [그를] 내보낼 것이다. 그는 자기 얼굴을 가려, 자기 눈으로 그 땅을 보지 못할 것이다.
ko.B: 그들 가운데 있는 군주도 어두울 때 짐을 어깨에 메고 나갈 것이다. 사람들이 벽을 뚫어 그 구멍으로 그를 내보낼 것이다. 그는 얼굴을 가려서 자기 눈으로 땅을 보지 못할 것이다.
ko.R: 백성의 통치자도 어두울 때 짐을 어깨에 메고 떠날 것이다. 그를 내보내려고 벽에 구멍을 뚫을 것이다. 그는 얼굴을 가려서 땅을 보지 못할 것이다.

fr.L: Et le prince qui [est] au milieu d’eux portera [sa charge] sur [son] épaule dans l’obscurité, et il sortira ; à travers le mur ils creuseront pour [le] faire sortir par là ; il couvrira sa face, afin de ne pas voir de [ses] yeux le pays.
fr.B: Le prince qui est parmi eux chargera son ballot sur son épaule dans l’obscurité et sortira. On percera le mur pour le faire sortir par là. Il se couvrira le visage pour ne pas voir le pays de ses yeux.
fr.R: Le chef du peuple mettra son ballot sur son épaule et partira dans le noir. On creusera un trou dans le mur pour le faire sortir. Il se couvrira le visage pour ne pas voir le pays.

vi.L: Còn thủ lĩnh ở giữa chúng sẽ vác [hành trang] lên vai trong bóng tối mà đi ra; chúng sẽ đục xuyên qua bức tường để đưa [ông] ra qua đó; ông sẽ che mặt mình, để chính ông không thấy đất bằng mắt mình.
vi.B: Thủ lĩnh ở giữa chúng sẽ vác gói đồ lên vai trong bóng tối mà đi ra. Chúng sẽ đục xuyên qua tường để đưa ông ra qua đó. Ông sẽ che mặt lại để mắt ông không thấy xứ.
vi.R: Người cai trị của dân sẽ vác gói đồ lên vai và ra đi trong bóng tối. Một lỗ sẽ được đục xuyên qua tường để đưa ông ra. Ông sẽ che mặt lại để không thấy được xứ.

am.L: በመካከላቸውም ያለው ገዥ በጨለማ በትከሻ ላይ [ጓዙን] ተሸክሞ ይወጣል፤ በእርሱ በኩል [እርሱን] ያወጡ ዘንድ ግድግዳውን ይነድላሉ፤ ምድሪቱን በዓይኑ እንዳያይ ፊቱን ይሸፍናል።
am.B: በመካከላቸው ያለው ገዥ ጓዙን በትከሻው ተሸክሞ በጨለማ ይወጣል። በዚያ በኩል ሊያወጡት ግድግዳውን ይነድላሉ። ምድሪቱን በዓይኖቹ እንዳያይ ፊቱን ይሸፍናል።
am.R: የሕዝቡ ገዥ ጓዙን በትከሻው ተሸክሞ በጨለማ ይወጣል። እርሱን ለማስወጣት ግድግዳው ይነደላል። ምድሪቱን እንዳያይ ፊቱን ይሸፍናል።

hi.L: और जो प्रधान उनके बीच [है], वह अँधेरे में [अपना बोझ] कंधे पर उठाकर निकलेगा; वे दीवार में सेंध लगाएँगे कि उसी में से [उसे] निकालें; वह अपना मुँह ढाँप लेगा, ताकि वह अपनी आँख से देश को न देखे।
hi.B: उनके बीच का प्रधान अँधेरे में अपनी गठरी कंधे पर उठाकर निकल जाएगा। उसे बाहर निकालने के लिए वे दीवार में छेद करेंगे। वह अपना मुँह ढाँप लेगा, ताकि वह अपनी आँखों से देश को न देख सके।
hi.R: लोगों का शासक अपनी गठरी कंधे पर रखकर अँधेरे में निकल जाएगा। उसे बाहर निकालने के लिए दीवार में छेद किया जाएगा। वह अपना मुँह ढक लेगा ताकि देश को न देख सके।

ru.L: И князь, который среди них, на плечо поднимет [ношу] в темноте и выйдет; через стену проломают, чтобы вывести [его] через неё; лицо своё он закроет, чтобы не видеть глазом землю.
ru.B: Князь, который среди них, в темноте поднимет свой узел на плечо и выйдет. Стену проломают, чтобы вывести его через неё. Он закроет лицо, чтобы не видеть земли своими глазами.
ru.R: Правитель народа положит свой узел на плечо и уйдёт в темноте. В стене проделают дыру, чтобы вывести его. Он закроет лицо, чтобы не видеть земли.

ja.L: そして彼らのただ中にいる君主は、暗闇の中で[荷物を]肩に担いで出て行く。人々は彼を運び出すために壁に穴を掘る。彼は、自分の目で地を見ないように、顔を覆う。
ja.B: 彼らの中にいる君主は、暗闇の中で荷物を肩に担いで出て行く。人々は彼を連れ出すために壁に穴を掘る。彼は顔を覆い、自分の目で地を見ることがない。
ja.R: 民の指導者は、荷物を肩に担いで、暗い中を出て行く。彼を連れ出すために、壁に穴が掘られる。彼は顔を覆うので、この地を見ることができない。

decisions.choice: the prince will go out in the dark through the wall: Zedekiah's flight from Jerusalem
decisions.reason: When the Babylonians broke into Jerusalem in 586 BC, Zedekiah and his soldiers fled by night through a gate between the two walls, toward the Jordan valley (2 Kings 25:4; Jeremiah 39:4; 52:7).

decisions.choice: so that he may not see the land: covering his face, and the blindness to come
decisions.reason: The clause may give the purpose of covering his face, or say that he will not see the land again. Either way it prepares for 12:13: he will be taken to Babylon and will not see it.

decisions.choice: A hole will be dug
decisions.reason: Readable avoids an unexplained "they".

decisions.choice: ’On percera le mur’
decisions.reason: The Hebrew ’they will dig’ has no named subject; French ’on’ says it naturally, as the English Readable’s passive does.

decisions.choice: yachteru "人々は…掘る" (L, B), "穴が掘られる" (R, the English passive); the king "彼" (a man).
decisions.reason: Zedekiah's flight through the wall (m1, 2 Kings 25:4); covering his face points to the blindness to come (m2).

source.text: וּפָרַשְׂתִּ֤י אֶת־רִשְׁתִּי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְנִתְפַּ֖שׂ בִּמְצֽוּדָתִ֑י וְהֵבֵאתִ֨י אֹת֤וֹ בָבֶ֨לָה֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים וְאוֹתָ֥הּ לֹֽא־יִרְאֶ֖ה וְשָׁ֥ם יָמֽוּת׃

records.literal_gloss: And I will spread my net over him, and he will be caught in my snare; and I will bring him to Babylon, [the] land of [the] Chaldeans; but it he will not see, and there he will die.

en.L: And I will spread {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} net over him, and he will be seized in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} snare; and I will bring him to Babylon, land of the Chaldeans; but it he will not see, and there he will die.
en.B: I will spread {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} net over him, and he will be trapped in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} snare. I will take him to Babylon, the land of the Chaldeans, but he will not see it, and he will die there.
en.R: But I will throw {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} net over him and catch him in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} trap. I will bring him to Babylon, the land of the Babylonians. But he will not see it, and he will die there.

pt.L: E estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} rede sobre ele, e ele será apanhado no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} laço; e o levarei à Babilônia, terra dos caldeus; mas não a verá, e ali morrerá.
pt.B: Estenderei a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} rede sobre ele, e ele ficará preso no {{deity_pronoun:meu|Meu}} laço. Eu o levarei à Babilônia, a terra dos caldeus, mas ele não a verá, e ali morrerá.
pt.R: Mas vou jogar a {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} rede sobre ele e pegá-lo na {{deity_pronoun:minha|Minha}} armadilha. Vou levá-lo à Babilônia, a terra dos babilônios. Mas ele não vai vê-la, e vai morrer lá.

es.L: Y extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} red sobre él, y será atrapado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lazo; y lo llevaré a Babilonia, tierra de los caldeos; pero no la verá, y allí morirá.
es.B: Extenderé {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} red sobre él, y quedará atrapado en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} trampa. Lo llevaré a Babilonia, la tierra de los caldeos, pero no la verá, y allí morirá.
es.R: Pero yo echaré {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} red sobre él y lo atraparé en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} trampa. Lo llevaré a Babilonia, la tierra de los babilonios. Pero no la verá, y morirá allí.

sw.L: Nami nitautandaza wavu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yake, naye atanaswa katika mtego {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamleta Babeli, nchi ya Wakaldayo; lakini hataiona, naye atafia huko.
sw.B: Nitautandaza wavu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} juu yake, naye atanaswa katika mtego {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nitampeleka Babeli, nchi ya Wakaldayo, lakini hataiona, naye atafia huko.
sw.R: Lakini nitamtupia wavu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}} na kumkamata katika mtego {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. Nitampeleka Babeli, nchi ya Wababeli. Lakini hataiona, naye atafia huko.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 내 그물을 그의 위에 펼칠 것이니, 그가 내 올무에 걸릴 것이다. 내가 그를 갈대아 사람들의 땅 바빌론으로 데려가겠으나, 그는 그곳을 보지 못하고 거기서 죽을 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그 위에 내 그물을 펼치면 그가 내 올무에 걸릴 것이다. 내가 그를 갈대아 사람들의 땅 바빌론으로 끌고 가겠으나, 그는 그 땅을 보지 못하고 거기에서 죽을 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 내가 그에게 내 그물을 던져서 내 덫으로 그를 잡겠다. 내가 그를 바빌로니아 사람들의 땅 바빌론으로 끌고 가겠다. 그러나 그는 그 땅을 보지 못하고 거기서 죽을 것이다.

fr.L: Et j’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} filet sur lui, et il sera pris dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} piège ; et je l’amènerai à Babylone, au pays des Chaldéens ; mais il ne le verra pas, et là il mourra.
fr.B: J’étendrai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} filet sur lui, et il sera pris dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} piège. Je l’emmènerai à Babylone, au pays des Chaldéens, mais il ne le verra pas, et c’est là qu’il mourra.
fr.R: Mais je lancerai {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} filet sur lui et je l’attraperai dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} piège. Je l’emmènerai à Babylone, au pays des Babyloniens. Mais il ne verra pas ce pays, et il y mourra.

vi.L: Ta sẽ giăng lưới của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên ông, và ông sẽ bị bắt trong bẫy của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ đem ông đến Ba-by-lôn, xứ của người Canh-đê; nhưng ông sẽ không thấy nó, và ông sẽ chết tại đó.
vi.B: Ta sẽ giăng lưới của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trên ông, và ông sẽ mắc vào bẫy của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ đem ông đến Ba-by-lôn, xứ của người Canh-đê, nhưng ông sẽ không thấy xứ ấy, và ông sẽ chết tại đó.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ quăng lưới của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} trùm lên ông và bắt ông trong bẫy của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Ta sẽ đem ông đến Ba-by-lôn, xứ của người Ba-by-lôn. Nhưng ông sẽ không thấy xứ ấy, và ông sẽ chết ở đó.

am.L: መረቤንም በእርሱ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ በወጥመዴም ይያዛል፤ ወደ ከለዳውያንም ምድር ወደ ባቢሎን አመጣዋለሁ፤ እርሷን ግን አያያትም፤ በዚያም ይሞታል።
am.B: መረቤን በእርሱ ላይ እዘረጋለሁ፤ በወጥመዴም ይጠመዳል። ወደ ከለዳውያን ምድር ወደ ባቢሎን እወስደዋለሁ፤ እርሷን ግን አያያትም፤ በዚያም ይሞታል።
am.R: እኔ ግን መረቤን በላዩ ጥዬ በወጥመዴ እይዘዋለሁ። ወደ ባቢሎናውያን ምድር ወደ ባቢሎን አመጣዋለሁ። እርሷን ግን አያያትም፤ በዚያም ይሞታል።

hi.L: और मैं उस पर अपना जाल फैलाऊँगा, और वह मेरे फंदे में पकड़ा जाएगा; और मैं उसे कसदियों के देश बाबुल में ले जाऊँगा; पर वह उसे न देखेगा, और वहीं मर जाएगा।
hi.B: मैं उस पर अपना जाल फैलाऊँगा, और वह मेरे फंदे में फँस जाएगा। मैं उसे कसदियों के देश बाबुल में ले जाऊँगा, पर वह उसे नहीं देखेगा, और वहीं मर जाएगा।
hi.R: पर मैं उस पर अपना जाल डालकर उसे अपने फंदे में पकड़ लूँगा। मैं उसे बाबुलियों के देश बाबुल में ले आऊँगा। पर वह उसे नहीं देख पाएगा, और वहीं मर जाएगा।

ru.L: И раскину {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} сеть над ним, и будет он пойман в {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} ловушку; и приведу его в Вавилон, землю халдеев; но её он не увидит, и там он умрёт.
ru.B: Я раскину над ним {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} сеть, и он попадёт в {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} ловушку. Я приведу его в Вавилон, в землю халдеев, но он её не увидит и там умрёт.
ru.R: Но {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} наброшу на него {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} сеть и поймаю его в {{deity_pronoun:мою|Мою}} ловушку. Я приведу его в Вавилон, в землю вавилонян. Но он её не увидит и умрёт там.

ja.L: わたしは彼の上にわたしの網を広げ、彼はわたしのわなに捕らえられる。わたしは彼を、カルデア人の地バビロンに連れて行く。しかし彼はそれを見ることなく、そこで死ぬ。
ja.B: わたしは彼の上にわたしの網を広げ、彼はわたしのわなに捕らえられる。わたしは彼を、カルデア人の地バビロンに連れて行く。しかし、彼はそれを見ることなく、そこで死ぬ。
ja.R: しかし、わたしは、わたしの網を彼の上に投げかけ、わたしのわなで彼を捕らえる。わたしは彼を、バビロニア人の地バビロンに連れて行く。しかし、彼はその地を見ることがなく、そこで死ぬ。

decisions.choice: he will not see Babylon, and there he will die: Zedekiah was blinded before he was taken there
decisions.reason: Zedekiah was captured near Jericho and brought to Nebuchadnezzar at Riblah, where his sons were killed in front of him and his eyes were put out. He was then taken to Babylon in chains and died there (2 Kings 25:5-7; Jeremiah 52:8-11).

decisions.choice: my net, my snare: the LORD himself captures the king
decisions.reason: The Babylonians caught Zedekiah, but the LORD calls the net his own, as in 17:20. The king's capture is the LORD's doing.

decisions.choice: the land of the Babylonians
decisions.reason: Readable says "Babylonians" for the Chaldeans, as the settled wording does.

decisions.choice: "los caldeos" (L, B); "los babilonios" (R)
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans as the Isaiah and Jeremiah terms note sets it for Spanish (2 Kings 25:4-5).

decisions.choice: No deity_pronoun spans in Korean, here or elsewhere in these chapters
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the setting has nothing to change; in God's own speech 나/내 is plain, and respect for God is carried by -시- and 께서 when others speak of him.

decisions.choice: "갈대아 사람들" (L, B), "바빌로니아 사람들" (R) for the Chaldeans
decisions.reason: The Isaiah-Jeremiah note's wording, matching 2 Kings 25 and Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: spans only on the free pronoun and possessive "nami", "wangu"
decisions.reason: Swahili marks most pronouns for God inside the verb (nitautandaza, nitampeleka), and a prefix cannot take a capital, so the deity_pronoun setting goes only on free pronouns and possessives ("wavu {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}", "{{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitamleta"). The Swahili of these chapters therefore has fewer spans than the English.

decisions.choice: "Wakaldayo" (L, B); "Wababeli" (R)
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans as a people, as in the Swahili Jeremiah and 2 Chronicles 36:17; Readable names them Babylonians, as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: God’s pronouns under deity_pronoun: possessives (’mon/Mon filet’), object and reflexive pronouns (’me/Me’, ’m’/M’’), and the stressed ’moi/Moi’ (’C’est moi, le SEIGNEUR, qui…’); never ’je’, and a pronoun that opens a sentence is written plainly with its capital (’Moi, le SEIGNEUR, j’ai parlé’); for the whole book
decisions.reason: As the French style guide and Isaiah and Jeremiah: the setting covers every pronoun French has for God except ’je’; a possessive agrees with its noun (’ma/Ma fureur’), and the start of a sentence takes its capital in any case.

decisions.choice: ’les Chaldéens’ (L, B); ’les Babyloniens’ (R)
decisions.reason: As Jeremiah and 2 Kings 25, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: बाबुलियों का देश
decisions.reason: Readable says Babylonians for the Chaldeans, as the English does; बाबुली, as 2 Kings and Jeremiah at Readable.

decisions.choice: землю вавилонян
decisions.reason: Readable says "вавилоняне" for the Chaldeans, as Jeremiah's Readable does.

decisions.choice: reshet / metsudah "網" / "わな" (kana; the same words as 17:20); "カルデア人の地バビロン" (L, B), "バビロニア人の地バビロン" (R), as 1:3; "それを見ることなく" without explaining the blinding.
decisions.reason: Zedekiah was blinded before he was taken to Babylon (m1, footnoted, 2 Kings 25:7); the text keeps the riddle, as the English. The LORD himself captures the king (m2).

source.text: וְכֹל֩ אֲשֶׁ֨ר סְבִיבֹתָ֥יו עֶזְר֛וֹ וְכָל־אֲגַפָּ֖יו אֱזָרֶ֣ה לְכָל־ר֑וּחַ וְחֶ֖רֶב אָרִ֥יק אַחֲרֵיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And all who [are] around him, his helpers and all his troops, I will scatter to every wind, and [the] sword I will unsheathe after them.

en.L: And all who [are] around him, his helpers and all his troops, I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw out the sword after them.
en.B: All those around him, his helpers and all his troops, I will scatter to every wind, and I will draw the sword to pursue them.
en.R: I will scatter in every direction all the people around him, his helpers and his soldiers. I will chase them with a sword.

pt.L: E todos os que [estão] ao redor dele, os seus ajudantes e todas as suas tropas, espalharei a todo vento, e desembainharei a espada atrás deles.
pt.B: Todos os que o cercam, os seus ajudantes e todas as suas tropas, espalharei a todos os ventos, e desembainharei a espada para persegui-los.
pt.R: Vou espalhar para todos os lados todas as pessoas que estão em volta dele, os seus ajudantes e os seus soldados. Vou persegui-los com a espada.

es.L: Y a todos los que [están] alrededor de él, a sus ayudantes y a todas sus tropas, los esparciré a todo viento, y desenvainaré la espada tras ellos.
es.B: A todos los que lo rodean, a sus ayudantes y a todas sus tropas, los esparciré a todos los vientos, y desenvainaré la espada para perseguirlos.
es.R: Dispersaré en todas direcciones a toda la gente que lo rodea, a sus ayudantes y a sus soldados. Los perseguiré con la espada.

sw.L: Na wote walio kumzunguka, wasaidizi wake na vikosi vyake vyote, nitawatawanya kwa kila upepo, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaufuta upanga nyuma yao.
sw.B: Wote walio karibu naye, wasaidizi wake na vikosi vyake vyote, nitawatawanya kila upande wa upepo, {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}} nitaufuta upanga ili kuwafuatia.
sw.R: Nitawatawanya pande zote watu wote walio karibu naye, wasaidizi wake na askari wake. Nitawafuatia kwa upanga.

ko.L: 그를 둘러싼 모든 자, 곧 그를 돕는 자들과 그의 모든 군대를 내가 사방의 바람에 흩어 버리고, 그들 뒤로 칼을 빼겠다.
ko.B: 그를 둘러싼 모든 사람, 곧 그를 돕는 자들과 그의 모든 군대를 내가 사방으로 흩어 버리고, 칼을 빼어 그들을 뒤쫓겠다.
ko.R: 그의 주변에 있는 모든 사람, 곧 그를 돕는 사람들과 그의 군인들을 내가 사방으로 흩어 버리겠다. 그리고 칼을 들고 그들을 뒤쫓겠다.

fr.L: Et tous ceux qui [sont] autour de lui, ses aides et toutes ses troupes, je les disperserai à tous les vents, et je tirerai l’épée derrière eux.
fr.B: Tous ceux qui l’entourent, ses aides et toutes ses troupes, je les disperserai à tous les vents, et je tirerai l’épée pour les poursuivre.
fr.R: Je disperserai dans toutes les directions tous ceux qui l’entourent, ses aides et ses soldats. Je les poursuivrai avec l’épée.

vi.L: Còn tất cả những kẻ ở quanh ông, những kẻ giúp đỡ ông và cả các toán quân của ông, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho tản lạc theo mọi luồng gió, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ rút gươm ra đuổi theo sau chúng.
vi.B: Tất cả những kẻ ở quanh ông, những kẻ giúp đỡ ông và mọi toán quân của ông, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ làm cho tản lạc theo mọi luồng gió, và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ rút gươm ra đuổi theo chúng.
vi.R: Ta sẽ làm cho tất cả những người ở quanh ông, những kẻ giúp đỡ và quân lính của ông, tản lạc khắp mọi hướng. Ta sẽ cầm gươm đuổi theo chúng.

am.L: በዙሪያው ያሉትን ሁሉ፣ ረዳቶቹንና ጭፍሮቹን ሁሉ ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናለሁ፤ ሰይፍንም በኋላቸው እመዝዛለሁ።
am.B: በዙሪያው ያሉትን ሁሉ፣ ረዳቶቹንና ጭፍሮቹን ሁሉ ወደ ነፋሳት ሁሉ እበትናለሁ፤ እነርሱንም ለማሳደድ ሰይፍ እመዝዛለሁ።
am.R: በዙሪያው ያሉትን ሰዎች ሁሉ፣ ረዳቶቹንና ወታደሮቹን ወደ ሁሉም አቅጣጫ እበትናለሁ። በሰይፍም አሳድዳቸዋለሁ።

hi.L: और जितने उसके चारों ओर [हैं], उसके सहायक और उसकी सब सेना, उन सबको मैं हर दिशा की हवा में तितर-बितर कर दूँगा, और उनके पीछे तलवार खींचूँगा।
hi.B: उसके चारों ओर के सब लोगों को, उसके सहायकों और उसकी सारी सेना को, मैं हर दिशा में तितर-बितर कर दूँगा, और उनका पीछा करने के लिए तलवार खींचूँगा।
hi.R: उसके आस-पास के सब लोगों को, उसके सहायकों और उसके सैनिकों को, मैं चारों ओर बिखेर दूँगा। मैं तलवार लेकर उनका पीछा करूँगा।

ru.L: И всех, кто вокруг него, его помощников и все его отряды, {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} развею по всем ветрам, и меч обнажу вслед за ними.
ru.B: Всех, кто вокруг него, его помощников и все его войска {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} развею по всем ветрам и обнажу меч им вслед.
ru.R: Я развею во все стороны всех, кто вокруг него, — его помощников и его воинов. Я буду преследовать их с мечом.

ja.L: そして彼の周りにいるすべての者、彼の助け手たちと彼のすべての部隊を、わたしはあらゆる風に散らし、彼らの後ろに剣を抜く。
ja.B: 彼の周りにいるすべての者、彼の助け手たちとそのすべての部隊を、わたしは四方の風に散らし、剣を抜いて彼らの後を追う。
ja.R: わたしは、彼の周りにいるすべての人々、彼を助ける者や兵士たちを、四方八方に散らす。剣を抜いて、彼らを追いかける。

decisions.choice: scatter to every wind and draw the sword after them: the words of 5:2, 12
decisions.reason: The same picture is used in 5:2 and 5:12. When Zedekiah was caught, his army scattered and left him (2 Kings 25:5).

decisions.choice: his troops: his bands of soldiers
decisions.reason: The word is used only by Ezekiel (17:21; 38:6, 9, 22; 39:4), always of an army's companies.

decisions.choice: "あらゆる風に散らし" (L), "四方の風に散らし" (B), "四方八方に散らす" (R); "I will draw out a sword after them" in the form of notes/EZK-EZK-1.md (5:2, 12).
decisions.reason: The words of 5:2, 12 (m1); 'agappav "部隊" (L, B), "兵士たち" (R) (m2).

source.text: וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֑ה בַּהֲפִיצִ֤י אוֹתָם֙ בַּגּוֹיִ֔ם וְזֵרִיתִ֥י אוֹתָ֖ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And they will know that I [am] Yahweh, when I disperse them among the nations and scatter them among the lands.

en.L: And they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I scatter them among the nations and disperse them in the lands.
en.B: Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I scatter them among the nations and spread them across the lands.
en.R: Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, when I scatter them among the nations and spread them through other lands.

pt.L: E saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, quando eu os dispersar entre as nações e os espalhar pelas terras.
pt.B: Então saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, quando eu os dispersar entre as nações e os espalhar pelas terras.
pt.R: Então saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, quando eu os espalhar entre as nações e por outras terras.

es.L: Y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando los disperse entre las naciones y los esparza por las tierras.
es.B: Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando los disperse entre las naciones y los esparza por los países.
es.R: Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, cuando los disperse entre las naciones y los esparza por otros países.

sw.L: Nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapowatawanya kati ya mataifa na kuwaeneza katika nchi.
sw.B: Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapowatawanya kati ya mataifa na kuwaeneza katika nchi mbalimbali.
sw.R: Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, nitakapowatawanya kati ya mataifa na kuwaeneza katika nchi nyingine.

ko.L: 그리고 내가 그들을 민족들 가운데 흩고 여러 나라에 퍼뜨릴 때, 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 내가 그들을 여러 민족 가운데로 흩고 여러 나라에 퍼뜨릴 때, 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 내가 그들을 여러 민족 가운데로 흩어 버리고 다른 나라들로 퍼뜨릴 것이다. 그때에 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

fr.L: Et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand je les disperserai parmi les nations et que je les répandrai dans les pays.
fr.B: Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand je les disperserai parmi les nations et que je les éparpillerai dans les pays.
fr.R: Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, quand je les disperserai parmi les nations et dans d’autres pays.

vi.L: Và chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho chúng tản lạc giữa các nước và rải chúng ra trong các xứ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, khi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho chúng tản lạc giữa các nước và phân tán chúng khắp các xứ.
vi.R: Khi ấy chúng sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, lúc {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} làm cho chúng tản lạc giữa các nước và phân tán chúng đi khắp các xứ khác.

am.L: በሕዝቦች መካከል በበተንኳቸውና በአገሮችም በዘራኋቸው ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ያውቃሉ።
am.B: በሕዝቦች መካከል ስበትናቸውና በአገሮች ሁሉ ስዘራቸው እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ያውቃሉ።
am.R: በሕዝቦች መካከል ስበትናቸውና በሌሎች አገሮች ስዘራቸው እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ያውቃሉ።

hi.L: और जब मैं उन्हें जातियों में तितर-बितर करूँगा और देशों में बिखेर दूँगा, तब वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।
hi.B: जब मैं उन्हें राष्ट्रों में तितर-बितर करूँगा और देशों में बिखेर दूँगा, तब वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।
hi.R: जब मैं उन्हें राष्ट्रों में तितर-बितर कर दूँगा और दूसरे देशों में भेज दूँगा, तब वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।

ru.L: И узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассею их среди народов и развею их по землям.
ru.B: Тогда они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассею их среди народов и развею по землям.
ru.R: Тогда они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}, когда {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} рассею их среди народов и разбросаю по другим землям.

ja.L: わたしが彼らを国々の中に散らし、諸国の地にまき散らすとき、彼らは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.B: わたしが彼らを国々の中に散らし、諸国の地に追い散らすとき、彼らは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。
ja.R: わたしが彼らを国々の中に散らし、ほかの国々に追い散らすとき、彼らは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。

decisions.choice: they will know that I am the LORD (see 6:7)
decisions.reason: See 6:7. Here it is the scattered people of Jerusalem who will know.

decisions.choice: "y sabrán que yo [soy] el SEÑOR" (L); "Entonces sabrán que yo soy el SEÑOR" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The refrain as the terms note sets it; with "you" it is "{{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}}". One wording is kept through the book.

decisions.choice: "nao watajua kwamba mimi [ni] BWANA" (L); "Ndipo watajua kwamba mimi ndimi BWANA" (B); "Ndipo watajua kwamba mimi ni BWANA" (R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's refrain, worded as Exodus 6:7 and 7:5 in Swahili, with "mtajua" for "you" and "watajua" for "they". The span goes on the free pronoun "mimi". Used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다" (L), "…알게 될 것이다" (B, R) for the recognition refrain
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording [1 Kings 20:13]; 인 줄 reads after both forms of the span. With the Lord GOD (13:9) it is 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}인 줄.

decisions.choice: ’et ils sauront que je [suis] le SEIGNEUR’ (L); ’Alors ils sauront que je suis le SEIGNEUR’ (B, R), with ’vous’, ’tu’ or ’ils’ as the Hebrew has it, for the whole book
decisions.reason: Ezekiel’s refrain, worded the same each time so the reader hears it return; ’savoir’ keeps the Hebrew verb ’know’.

decisions.choice: "và chúng sẽ biết rằng Ta [là] CHÚA" (L); "Bấy giờ chúng sẽ biết rằng Ta là CHÚA" (B); "Khi ấy chúng sẽ biết Ta là CHÚA" (R)
alternatives: "thì chúng sẽ biết ta là Đức Giê-hô-va"
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording of Ezekiel's refrain, one form per level through the book, as Exodus 7:5; "chúng" for those being judged, "các ngươi" where the people are addressed (12:20).

decisions.choice: वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's refrain keeps one wording at each level (see 11:10); Literal brackets हूँ.

source.text: וְהוֹתַרְתִּ֤י מֵהֶם֙ אַנְשֵׁ֣י מִסְפָּ֔ר מֵחֶ֖רֶב מֵרָעָ֣ב וּמִדָּ֑בֶר לְמַ֨עַן יְסַפְּר֜וּ אֶת־כָּל־תּוֹעֲבֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם בַּגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁר־בָּ֣אוּ שָׁ֔ם וְיָדְע֖וּ כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: But I will leave of them men few in number from [the] sword, from famine and from pestilence, so that they may recount all their abominations among the nations where they go; and they will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: But I will leave a few {{gender:people|men}} of them from the sword, from famine and from pestilence, so that they may recount all their abominations among the nations where they go; and they will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But I will spare a few of them from the sword, famine and plague, so that among the nations where they go they may tell about all their detestable practices. Then they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But I will let a few of them live through the war, famine and disease. Then they can tell the nations where they go about all the disgusting things they did. And they will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: Mas deixarei deles {{gender:umas poucas pessoas|uns poucos homens}} [que escapem] da espada, da fome e da peste, para que contem todas as suas abominações entre as nações para onde forem; e saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Mas pouparei alguns deles da espada, da fome e da peste, para que contem, entre as nações para onde forem, todas as suas práticas detestáveis. Então saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Mas vou deixar alguns deles escaparem da guerra, da fome e da doença. Assim eles poderão contar às nações para onde forem todas as coisas repugnantes que fizeram. E saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

es.L: Pero dejaré de ellos {{gender:unas pocas personas|unos pocos hombres}} [que escapen] de la espada, del hambre y de la peste, para que cuenten todas sus abominaciones entre las naciones adonde vayan; y sabrán que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero libraré a unos pocos de ellos de la espada, del hambre y de la peste, para que cuenten todas sus prácticas detestables entre las naciones adonde vayan. Entonces sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero dejaré que unos pocos de ellos sobrevivan a la guerra, al hambre y a las enfermedades. Así podrán contarles a las naciones adonde vayan todas las cosas repugnantes que hicieron. Y sabrán que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Lakini nitawasaza watu wachache kati yao kutoka kwa upanga, kutoka kwa njaa na kutoka kwa tauni, ili wasimulie machukizo yao yote kati ya mataifa watakakokwenda; nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini nitawaepusha wachache wao na upanga, njaa na tauni, ili wasimulie matendo yao yote ya kuchukiza kati ya mataifa watakakokwenda. Ndipo watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini nitawaacha wachache wao waokoke vita, njaa na magonjwa. Ndipo wataweza kuyaambia mataifa watakakokwenda habari za mambo yote ya kinyaa waliyoyatenda. Nao watajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그러나 내가 그들 가운데 몇 사람을 칼과 기근과 전염병에서 남겨 두어, 그들이 가는 민족들 가운데서 자기들의 모든 가증한 일을 이야기하게 하겠다. 그리고 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
ko.B: 그러나 내가 그들 가운데 몇 사람은 칼과 기근과 전염병에서 살아남게 하여, 그들이 가는 민족들 가운데서 자기들이 저지른 모든 역겨운 짓을 이야기하게 하겠다. 그러면 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.
ko.R: 그러나 내가 그들 가운데 몇 사람은 전쟁과 굶주림과 질병에서 살아남게 하겠다. 그러면 그들이 가는 곳마다 그 민족들에게 자기들이 한 역겨운 일을 모두 이야기할 것이다. 그리고 그들은 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알게 될 것이다.

fr.L: Mais je laisserai d’entre eux quelques {{gender:personnes|hommes}} [qui échapperont] à l’épée, à la famine et à la peste, afin qu’ils racontent toutes leurs abominations parmi les nations où ils iront ; et ils sauront que je [suis] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais j’épargnerai quelques-uns d’entre eux, qui échapperont à l’épée, à la famine et à la peste, afin qu’ils racontent toutes leurs pratiques détestables parmi les nations où ils iront. Alors ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Mais je laisserai quelques-uns d’entre eux survivre à la guerre, à la famine et à la maladie. Ils pourront alors raconter aux nations où ils iront toutes les choses dégoûtantes qu’ils ont faites. Et ils sauront que je suis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

vi.L: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chừa lại một số ít người trong chúng khỏi gươm, khỏi nạn đói và khỏi ôn dịch, để chúng thuật lại mọi điều ghê tởm của chúng giữa các nước nơi chúng đến; và chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} [là] {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ chừa lại một số ít người trong chúng thoát khỏi gươm đao, nạn đói và dịch bệnh, để giữa các nước nơi chúng đến, chúng kể lại mọi việc làm ghê tởm của mình. Bấy giờ chúng sẽ biết rằng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhưng {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ để cho một ít người trong chúng sống sót qua chiến tranh, nạn đói và bệnh tật. Rồi chúng sẽ kể cho các dân nơi chúng đến về mọi việc ghê tởm chúng đã làm. Khi ấy chúng sẽ biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

am.L: ነገር ግን በሄዱባቸው ሕዝቦች መካከል አስጸያፊ ነገሮቻቸውን ሁሉ ይናገሩ ዘንድ፣ ከእነርሱ ቁጥራቸው ጥቂት የሆኑ ሰዎችን ከሰይፍ፣ ከራብና ከቸነፈር አስቀራለሁ፤ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ያውቃሉ።
am.B: ነገር ግን በሄዱባቸው ሕዝቦች መካከል አስጸያፊ ነገሮቻቸውን ሁሉ እንዲናገሩ፣ ከእነርሱ ጥቂቶቹን ከሰይፍ፣ ከራብና ከቸነፈር አተርፋለሁ። በዚያን ጊዜ እኔ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} እንደ ሆንኩ ያውቃሉ።

hi.L: पर उनमें से थोड़े से लोगों को मैं तलवार से, अकाल से और महामारी से बचा रखूँगा, ताकि जिन जातियों में वे जाएँ, उनके बीच वे अपने सब घृणित कामों का वर्णन करें; और वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} [हूँ]।
hi.B: पर मैं उनमें से थोड़े से लोगों को तलवार, अकाल और महामारी से बचा लूँगा, ताकि जिन देशों में वे जाएँ, वहाँ वे अपनी सब घृणित प्रथाओं के बारे में बताएँ। तब वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।
hi.R: पर मैं उनमें से कुछ लोगों को युद्ध, अकाल और बीमारी से जीवित बचा लूँगा। तब जिन देशों में वे जाएँगे, वहाँ के लोगों को वे उन सब घिनौने कामों के बारे में बता सकेंगे जो उन्होंने किए। तब वे जान लेंगे कि मैं {{divine_name:प्रभु|याहवे}} हूँ।

ru.L: Но оставлю из них {{gender:немногих людей|немногих мужей}} от меча, от голода и от мора, чтобы они рассказали обо всех своих мерзостях среди народов, куда придут; и узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.B: Но немногих из них {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} сохраню от меча, голода и мора, чтобы среди народов, куда они придут, они рассказали обо всех своих мерзких делах. Тогда они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.
ru.R: Но некоторым из них {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} дам пережить войну, голод и болезни. Тогда они смогут рассказать народам, к которым придут, обо всём отвратительном, что они делали. Тогда они узнают, что {{deity_pronoun:я|Я}} — {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}}.

ja.L: しかしわたしは、彼らのうちのわずかな者を、剣と飢饉と疫病から残す。それは、彼らが行く国々の中で、自分たちのすべての忌み嫌うべきことを語り告げるためである。そして彼らは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知る。
ja.B: しかし、わたしは彼らのうちのわずかな者を、剣と飢饉と疫病から免れさせる。それは、彼らが行く国々の中で、自分たちのすべての忌まわしい行いを語るためである。そのとき、彼らは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。
ja.R: しかし、わたしは彼らのうちのわずかな人々を、戦争とききんと疫病から生き残らせる。そうすれば、彼らは、自分たちが行く国々の人々に、自分たちがしたひどく汚らわしいことを、すべて話すことができる。そして彼らは、わたしが{{divine_name:主|ヤハウェ}}であることを知るようになる。

decisions.choice: a few survivors as witnesses: their own account shows why the judgment came
decisions.reason: The few who survive will tell the nations what they did, so that the nations see that the LORD's judgment was just. The same thought returns in 14:22-23.

decisions.choice: "they will know": the survivors, or the nations who hear them
decisions.reason: The subject is not named. It may be the survivors themselves or the nations who hear their story; the verse allows both.

decisions.choice: sword, famine and pestilence (L); sword, famine and plague (B); war, famine and disease (R)
decisions.reason: The settled wording for this list, from the Jeremiah table.

decisions.choice: a few {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for "men" here means people; the survivors are not only men. Balanced and Readable say "a few of them", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "abominaciones" (L); "prácticas detestables" (B); "cosas repugnantes" (R)
decisions.reason: To'evah as the terms note sets it (2 Kings 21:2, 11), kept apart from shiqqutsim throughout Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "la espada, el hambre y la peste" (L, B); "la guerra, el hambre y las enfermedades" (R)
decisions.reason: The triad as published (2 Chronicles 20:9) and in Jeremiah.

decisions.choice: "{{gender:unas pocas personas|unos pocos hombres}}"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "men" here means survivors of either sex; the default says "personas", the alternative keeps "hombres".

decisions.choice: "upanga, njaa na tauni" (L, B); "vita, njaa na magonjwa" (R)
decisions.reason: The settled Swahili wording of this list, as in Jeremiah and 2 Samuel 24:13.

decisions.choice: "machukizo" (L); "matendo ya kuchukiza" (B); "mambo ya kinyaa" (R) for to'evah
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's word for abominations, as the Swahili Deuteronomy 18:12 words it at each level. Used the same way through these chapters.

decisions.choice: "watu wachache", with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal has a gender span here ("people|men"). Swahili "watu" already means people of both sexes, and the only other wording, "wanaume", would mean males only and change the sense, so Swahili has no span. The same holds wherever the English has a gender span in these chapters.

decisions.choice: "가증한 일" (L), "역겨운 짓" (B), "역겨운 일" (R) for to'evah, through these chapters
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording, as Deuteronomy 18:12 and 1 Kings 21:26.

decisions.choice: "몇 사람" with no gender span, where the English Literal has {{gender:people|men}}
decisions.reason: 사람 already covers men and women, so Korean has only one wording and no span.

decisions.choice: ’abomination’ (L); ’pratique détestable’ (B); ’chose dégoûtante’ (R) for toevah, for the whole book
decisions.reason: The wording of Deuteronomy 18:12 at each level, as the book’s term list asks.

decisions.choice: ’l’épée, la famine et la peste’ (L, B); ’la guerre, la famine et la maladie’ (R)
decisions.reason: The triad as Jeremiah words it, following the English levels.

decisions.choice: to'evah: "điều ghê tởm" (L); "việc làm ghê tởm" (B); "việc ghê tởm" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's forms, as Deuteronomy 18:12; used unchanged through these chapters. The sword, famine and plague take the Jeremiah wordings.

decisions.choice: "một số ít người", with no gender span
decisions.reason: "Người" already covers men and women, so the English Literal's gender setting has no Vietnamese counterpart here.

decisions.choice: no gender span: "ሰዎች"
decisions.reason: The English offers "people|men" for anshei; Amharic "ሰዎች" already covers both, so the Amharic has no span.

decisions.choice: "ሰይፍ፣ ራብና ቸነፈር" (L, B); "ጦርነት፣ ራብና በሽታ" (R)
decisions.reason: The triad keeps Jeremiah's order and wording; Readable follows the English "war, famine and disease".

decisions.choice: तलवार, अकाल और महामारी (L, B); युद्ध, अकाल और बीमारी (R)
decisions.reason: The list keeps the wording of Jeremiah 24:10 at each level.

decisions.choice: थोड़े से लोग, with no gender span
decisions.reason: The English Literal sets "people" against "men" with the gender setting. The Hindi लोग already means people of either sex, so the Hindi needs no span.

decisions.choice: меч, голод и мор (L, B); война, голод и болезни (R)
decisions.reason: The list in the wording Jeremiah uses (24:10).

decisions.choice: The triad "剣と飢饉と疫病" (L, B), "戦争とききんと疫病" (R), in the Hebrew order, as notes/EZK-EZK-1.md.
decisions.reason: The book-wide forms (5:12, 6:11).

decisions.choice: 'anshe mispar "わずかな者" with no gender span, where the English L has {{gender:people|men}}.
decisions.reason: "者" is already inclusive in Japanese (style §7a), so no span is needed; the survivors are witnesses whose own account shows why the judgment came (m1).

en.R: Son of man, shake as you eat your food. Tremble with worry as you drink your water.

ja.R: 人よ、体を震わせながら食べ物を食べなさい。心配で震えながら水を飲みなさい。

source.text: וְאָמַרְתָּ֣ אֶל־עַ֣ם הָאָ֡רֶץ כֹּֽה־אָמַר֩ אֲדֹנָ֨י יְהוִ֜ה לְיוֹשְׁבֵ֤י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶל־אַדְמַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַחְמָם֙ בִּדְאָגָ֣ה יֹאכֵ֔לוּ וּמֵֽימֵיהֶ֖ם בְּשִׁמָּמ֣וֹן יִשְׁתּ֑וּ לְמַ֜עַן תֵּשַׁ֤ם אַרְצָהּ֙ מִמְּלֹאָ֔הּ מֵחֲמַ֖ס כָּֽל־הַיֹּשְׁבִ֥ים בָּֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And say to [the] people of the land, Thus says [the] Lord Yahweh concerning [the] inhabitants of Jerusalem on [the] soil of Israel: Their bread with anxiety they will eat, and their water with horror they will drink, so that its land may be desolate of its fullness, because of [the] violence of all those living in it.

en.L: And say to the people of the land, Thus says the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} concerning the inhabitants of Jerusalem on the soil of Israel: Their bread they will eat with anxiety, and their water they will drink with horror, so that its land may be stripped of its fullness because of the violence of all who live in it.
en.B: Say to the people of the land: The Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says this about those who live in Jerusalem, in the land of Israel: They will eat their food with anxiety and drink their water in horror, for their land will be stripped of all it holds because of the violence of everyone who lives there.
en.R: Say to the people of the land: This is what the Lord {{divine_name:GOD|Yahweh}} says about the people living in Jerusalem, in the land of Israel: They will be worried as they eat their food, and terrified as they drink their water. Their land will be stripped bare because of all the violence of the people who live there.

pt.L: E dize ao povo da terra: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} a respeito dos habitantes de Jerusalém, no solo de Israel: O seu pão comerão com ansiedade, e a sua água beberão com horror, para que a sua terra seja despojada da sua plenitude, por causa da violência de todos os que nela habitam.
pt.B: Dize ao povo da terra: Assim diz o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} a respeito dos que moram em Jerusalém, na terra de Israel: Comerão o seu pão com ansiedade e beberão a sua água com horror, pois a terra deles será despojada de tudo o que contém, por causa da violência de todos os que moram nela.
pt.R: Diz ao povo da terra: É isto que o Senhor {{divine_name:DEUS|Javé}} diz sobre as pessoas que moram em Jerusalém, na terra de Israel: Elas vão ficar preocupadas enquanto comem e apavoradas enquanto bebem a sua água. A terra delas vai ficar sem nada, por causa de toda a violência das pessoas que moram ali.

es.L: Y di al pueblo de la tierra: Así dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} acerca de los habitantes de Jerusalén en el suelo de Israel: Su pan comerán con ansiedad, y su agua beberán con espanto, para que su tierra quede despojada de su plenitud, a causa de la violencia de todos los que habitan en ella.
es.B: Di al pueblo de la tierra: El Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} dice esto acerca de los que viven en Jerusalén, en la tierra de Israel: Comerán su comida con angustia y beberán su agua con espanto, porque su tierra quedará despojada de todo lo que contiene a causa de la violencia de todos los que viven en ella.
es.R: Dile a la gente del país: Esto es lo que dice el Señor {{divine_name:DIOS|Yahvé}} acerca de la gente que vive en Jerusalén, en la tierra de Israel: Estarán preocupados mientras coman su comida y aterrados mientras beban su agua. Su tierra quedará arrasada por toda la violencia de los que viven allí.

sw.L: Na uwaambie watu wa nchi, Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asema hivi kuhusu wakaao Yerusalemu katika ardhi ya Israeli: Mkate wao watakula kwa wasiwasi, na maji yao watakunywa kwa hofu kuu, ili nchi yake inyang'anywe vyote vilivyomo kwa sababu ya ukatili wa wote wanaokaa ndani yake.
sw.B: Waambie watu wa nchi: Hivi ndivyo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} asemavyo kuhusu wakazi wa Yerusalemu katika nchi ya Israeli: Watakula chakula chao kwa wasiwasi na kunywa maji yao kwa hofu kuu, kwa maana nchi yao itanyang'anywa vyote vilivyomo kwa sababu ya ukatili wa wote wanaoishi humo.
sw.R: Waambie watu wa nchi: Hili ndilo Bwana {{divine_name:MUNGU|Yahwe}} analosema kuhusu watu wanaoishi Yerusalemu, katika nchi ya Israeli: Watakuwa na wasiwasi wanapokula chakula chao, na wataogopa sana wanapokunywa maji yao. Nchi yao itaachwa tupu kwa sababu ya ukatili wote wa watu wanaoishi humo.

ko.L: 그리고 그 땅의 백성에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 땅에 있는 예루살렘 주민들에 대하여 이와 같이 말씀하신다. 그들이 근심하며 자기 빵을 먹고, 놀라며 자기 물을 마실 것이다. 그 땅에 사는 모든 자의 폭력 때문에, 그 땅이 그 안에 가득한 것을 잃고 황폐해질 것이기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그 땅의 백성에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 땅 예루살렘에 사는 사람들에 대하여 이렇게 말씀하신다. 그들은 근심하며 음식을 먹고, 두려워하며 물을 마실 것이다. 그곳에 사는 모든 사람이 저지른 폭력 때문에 그 땅에 있는 모든 것이 다 없어질 것이다.
ko.R: 그 땅의 백성에게 말하여라. 주 {{divine_name:하나님|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 땅 예루살렘에 사는 사람들에 대하여 하시는 말씀이다. 그들은 걱정하면서 음식을 먹고, 무서워 떨면서 물을 마실 것이다. 그곳에 사는 사람들이 저지른 온갖 폭력 때문에 그 땅은 텅 비게 될 것이다.

fr.L: Et dis au peuple du pays : Ainsi parle le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} au sujet des habitants de Jérusalem, sur le sol d’Israël : Ils mangeront leur pain avec inquiétude, et ils boiront leur eau avec effroi, afin que son pays soit dépouillé de ce qui le remplit, à cause de la violence de tous ceux qui y habitent.
fr.B: Dis au peuple du pays : Le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} dit ceci au sujet des habitants de Jérusalem, sur la terre d’Israël : Ils mangeront leur nourriture avec inquiétude et boiront leur eau avec effroi, car leur pays sera dépouillé de tout ce qu’il contient, à cause de la violence de tous ceux qui y habitent.
fr.R: Dis au peuple du pays : Voici ce que dit le Seigneur {{divine_name:DIEU|Yahvé}} au sujet des gens qui vivent à Jérusalem, dans le pays d’Israël : Ils seront inquiets en mangeant leur nourriture, et terrifiés en buvant leur eau. Leur pays sera complètement vidé, à cause de toute la violence de ceux qui y habitent.

vi.L: Và hãy nói với dân trong xứ: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán thế này về dân cư Giê-ru-sa-lem trên đất của Y-sơ-ra-ên: Chúng sẽ ăn bánh mình trong sự lo âu, và uống nước mình trong sự kinh hãi, để xứ của nó bị lột sạch mọi vật trong đó, vì sự bạo ngược của mọi kẻ sống trong đó.
vi.B: Hãy nói với dân trong xứ: Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán như vầy về những người sống tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, trong đất Y-sơ-ra-ên: Chúng sẽ ăn bánh trong lo âu và uống nước trong kinh hãi, vì xứ của chúng sẽ bị lột sạch mọi thứ trong đó, bởi sự bạo ngược của mọi kẻ sống ở đó.
vi.R: Hãy nói với dân trong xứ rằng đây là lời Chúa là {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán về những người đang sống ở Giê-ru-sa-lem, trong xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên: Chúng sẽ lo lắng khi ăn và kinh hãi khi uống nước. Xứ của chúng sẽ bị cướp sạch, vì mọi sự bạo ngược của những kẻ sống ở đó.

am.L: ለምድሪቱም ሕዝብ እንዲህ በል፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእስራኤል መሬት ስላሉት ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ነዋሪዎች እንዲህ ይላል፦ እንጀራቸውን በጭንቀት ይበላሉ፤ ውኃቸውንም በድንጋጤ ይጠጣሉ፤ ይህም በውስጧ በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ግፍ ምክንያት ምድሯ ከሞላባት ነገር ሁሉ ባዶ እንድትሆን ነው።
am.B: ለምድሪቱም ሕዝብ እንዲህ በል፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእስራኤል ምድር ስለሚኖሩት ስለ ኢየሩሳሌም ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላል፦ ምግባቸውን በጭንቀት ይበላሉ፤ ውኃቸውንም በድንጋጤ ይጠጣሉ፤ በዚያ በሚኖሩት ሁሉ ግፍ ምክንያት ምድራቸው ያላት ሁሉ ይወሰድባታልና።
am.R: ለምድሪቱም ሕዝብ እንዲህ በል፦ ጌታ {{divine_name:እግዚአብሔር|ያህዌ}} በእስራኤል ምድር በኢየሩሳሌም ስለሚኖሩ ሰዎች እንዲህ ይላል፦ ምግባቸውን ሲበሉ ይጨነቃሉ፤ ውኃቸውንም ሲጠጡ ይሸበራሉ። በዚያ የሚኖሩ ሰዎች ሁሉ ከፈጸሙት ግፍ የተነሣ ምድራቸው ባዶ ትቀራለች።

hi.L: और देश के लोगों से कहो, प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} इस्राएल की भूमि पर रहनेवाले यरूशलेम के निवासियों के विषय में यों कहते हैं: वे अपनी रोटी चिंता के साथ खाएँगे, और अपना पानी घबराहट के साथ पिएँगे, ताकि उसका देश उसमें रहनेवाले सब लोगों के उपद्रव के कारण अपनी भरपूरी से उजड़ जाए।
hi.B: देश के लोगों से कहो: प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} इस्राएल देश में यरूशलेम के रहनेवालों के विषय में यह कहते हैं: वे चिंता के साथ अपना भोजन खाएँगे और घबराहट के साथ अपना पानी पिएँगे, क्योंकि वहाँ रहनेवाले सब लोगों के उपद्रव के कारण उनका देश अपनी सारी उपज से ख़ाली कर दिया जाएगा।
hi.R: देश के लोगों से कहो कि प्रभु {{divine_name:परमेश्वर|याहवे}} इस्राएल देश में यरूशलेम के रहनेवालों के बारे में यह कहते हैं: वे भोजन करते समय चिंता में रहेंगे, और पानी पीते समय डर से काँपेंगे। वहाँ रहनेवाले लोगों की सारी हिंसा के कारण उनका देश उजाड़ हो जाएगा।

ru.L: И скажи народу земли: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о жителях Иерусалима на земле Израиля: Свой хлеб они будут есть с тревогой и свою воду пить в ужасе, чтобы опустела их земля от того, что наполняет её, из-за насилия всех живущих в ней.
ru.B: Скажи народу земли: Так говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о жителях Иерусалима, на земле Израиля: Они будут есть свою еду с тревогой и пить свою воду в ужасе, потому что их земля лишится всего, что наполняет её, из-за насилия всех, кто живёт в ней.
ru.R: Скажи народу этой земли: Вот что говорит Владыка {{divine_name:ГОСПОДЬ|Яхве}} о людях, которые живут в Иерусалиме, в земле Израиля: Они будут есть свою еду в тревоге и пить свою воду в страхе. Их земля опустеет из-за насилия всех, кто живёт в ней.

ja.L: そして国の民に言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエルの地にいるエルサレムの住民について、こう言われる。彼らは自分のパンを不安のうちに食べ、自分の水をおびえながら飲む。その地が、そこに住むすべての者の暴虐のゆえに、その満ちているものを奪われて荒れ果てるためである。
ja.B: 国の民に言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエルの地のエルサレムに住む者たちについて、こう言われる。彼らは不安のうちに食べ物を食べ、おびえながら水を飲む。そこに住むすべての者の暴虐のために、その地はそこにあるものをすべて奪われ、荒れ果てるからである。
ja.R: 国中の人々に言いなさい。{{divine_name:主なる神|主ヤハウェ}}は、イスラエルの地のエルサレムに住む人々について、こう言われる。彼らは心配しながら食べ物を食べ、おびえながら水を飲むことになる。そこに住む人々がふるった暴力のために、その地は何もかも奪われ、荒れ果てる。

decisions.choice: the people of the land: here, the people Ezekiel speaks to
alternatives: the landowners of Judah, as the phrase often means
decisions.reason: Elsewhere the phrase can mean the landowning citizens of Judah (2 Kings 11:14; 23:30). Here Ezekiel is told to speak to "the people of the land" about those in Jerusalem, so it probably means the people in general, the exiles around him.

decisions.choice: so that its land may be stripped of its fullness: the result of the siege, and its cause
decisions.reason: The clause gives the outcome: the land will be emptied of all it contains. "Because of the violence" gives the reason (compare 7:23; 8:17; 9:9).

decisions.choice: the soil of Israel: Ezekiel's phrase for the land (see 11:17)
"el suelo de Israel" (L); "la tierra de Israel" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Ezekiel's phrase admat yisrael: Literal keeps "suelo", the other levels say the land, as the English does.

decisions.choice: ’le sol d’Israël’ (L); ’la terre d’Israël’ (B); ’le pays d’Israël’ (R) for admat Yisrael, for the whole book
decisions.reason: Ezekiel’s own phrase uses the word for soil; Literal keeps ’sol’, Balanced ’terre’, which keeps it apart from ’pays’ (erets) in the same verses, and Readable the plain ’pays’, as the English.

decisions.choice: 'admat yisra'el: "đất của Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L); "đất Y-sơ-ra-ên" (B); "xứ Y-sơ-ra-ên" (R)
decisions.reason: "Đất" keeps Ezekiel's word for the soil of the land at Literal and Balanced; Readable uses the plain "xứ". Used for this phrase through these chapters.

decisions.choice: उपद्रव (L, B); हिंसा (R)
decisions.reason: Violence (hamas) is उपद्रव, the wrongdoing that fills the land; Readable says the everyday हिंसा.

decisions.choice: 'am ha'arets "国の民" (L, B), "国中の人々" (R), as 7:27; hamas "暴虐" (L, B), "暴力" (R); tesham "荒れ果てる".
decisions.reason: Who 'the people of the land' are here is uncertain (m1); the book-wide forms are kept. The siege and its cause in one clause (m2).

source.text: וְהֶעָרִ֤ים הַנּֽוֹשָׁבוֹת֙ תֶּחֱרַ֔בְנָה וְהָאָ֖רֶץ שְׁמָמָ֣ה תִֽהְיֶ֑ה וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And the cities the inhabited will be laid waste, and the land a desolation will be; and you will know that I [am] Yahweh.

en.L: And the inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will be a desolation; and you will know that I [am] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: The cities where people live will be laid waste, and the land will become a desolation. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: The towns where people now live will be destroyed, and the land will be empty and ruined. Then you will know that I am {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

pt.L: E as cidades habitadas serão assoladas, e a terra será uma desolação; e vocês saberão que eu [sou] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: As cidades onde o povo mora serão arrasadas, e a terra se tornará uma desolação. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: As cidades onde as pessoas agora moram vão ser destruídas, e a terra vai ficar vazia e arrasada. Então vocês saberão que eu sou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

es.L: Y las ciudades habitadas serán asoladas, y la tierra será una desolación; y {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo [soy] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Las ciudades habitadas quedarán en ruinas, y la tierra será una desolación. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.R: Las ciudades donde ahora vive la gente serán destruidas, y la tierra quedará vacía y en ruinas. Entonces {{plural_you:sabrán|sabréis}} que yo soy {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Na miji inayokaliwa itaharibiwa, na nchi itakuwa ukiwa; nanyi mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Miji inayokaliwa na watu itaharibiwa, na nchi itakuwa ukiwa. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ndimi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Miji ambamo watu wanaishi sasa itaharibiwa, na nchi itakuwa tupu na magofu. Ndipo mtajua kwamba {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}} ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

ko.L: 그리고 사람이 사는 성읍들이 황폐해지고, 그 땅은 황무지가 될 것이다. 그리고 너희는 내가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}인 줄 알 것이다.
